author: Hiring Manager
title: Lead Technical Product Manager
job_description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

The Lead Technical Product Manager is responsible for defining product strategy, roadmap, and delivery execution for technology products and platforms. This role bridges business objectives and engineering capabilities to deliver scalable, high-quality solutions that drive customer and business value. The position owns product vision, backlog prioritization, stakeholder alignment, feature planning, and product performance across the product lifecycle.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Define and execute product vision, strategy, and roadmap aligned with business goals
* Partner with engineering, architecture, UX, data, and business teams to deliver impactful product outcomes
* Manage and prioritize product backlogs, features, and user stories based on customer needs and business value
* Translate customer insights and business requirements into actionable product requirements
* Drive product planning, release management, and continuous improvement activities
* Balance customer experience, business priorities, technical constraints, and operational needs
* Lead cross-functional stakeholder discussions and facilitate alignment on priorities and tradeoffs
* Monitor product performance, adoption, and value realization using data-driven decision making
* Ensure compliance with governance, security, and enterprise technology standards
* Communicate roadmap progress, risks, and strategic direction to senior leadership
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field
* 8+ years of experience in Product Management, Technical Product Management, Software Engineering, or related technology roles
* Experience delivering enterprise-scale technology products in Agile environments
* Experience with Agile delivery tools such as Aha!, Rally, Jira, GitHub, or similar platforms
* Solid understanding of software development lifecycle, cloud technologies, APIs, data flows, and modern architecture patterns
* Proven ability to influence cross-functional teams and drive strategic outcomes

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Healthcare, payer, provider, or regulated industry experience
* Experience leading AI/ML, data, analytics, or digital transformation initiatives
* Knowledge of product operating models, OKRs, roadmap management, and value-stream delivery
* Proven solid executive communication and stakeholder management skills

**Key Competencies**

* Product Strategy & Roadmap Management
* Customer-Centric Product Development
* Technical Acumen & Systems Thinking
* Agile Product Delivery
* Stakeholder Management & Influence
* Data-Driven Decision Making
* Leadership & Team Collaboration
* Strategic Planning & Execution

**Success Measures**

* Product adoption and customer satisfaction
* Delivery against roadmap commitments
* Business value realization and outcomes
* Stakeholder satisfaction and engagement
* Product quality, reliability, and operational performance
* Team effectiveness and cross-functional collaboration

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product Manager - APAC
job_description:
Date live: 10/22/2026

Business Area: Investing and Lending

Area of Expertise: Investment Banking

Contract: Permanent

Reference Code: JR-0000131619

  

Join us as Senior Product Manager - APAC, where you will be responsible for the development and oversight of our loan and overdraft products across India, broader Asia and the Middle East. You will work closely with loan originators and broader stakeholders across the region, including coordinating new product approvals, performing annual product reviews, and acting as the business product owner in the region to help prioritise technology and process changes. You will also work closely with Operations and Technology on the rollout of our strategic loan platform across the region. The role will sit with our Investment Banking Origination team in Mumbai and report jointly to the Global Head of Loan Product Management and the Global Head of Loan Transformation.

  
  

To be successful in this role, you should:

Be a strong and ambitious candidate at Vice President level with strong product management, business analysis, stakeholder management and loan product knowledge, along with the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

  
  

Essential Skills/Basic Qualifications:

* Strong business analysis skills, including the ability to capture key requirements.
* Strong bilateral and syndicated loan product knowledge.
* Strong communication, relationship management and networking skills.
* Strong product management skills.
* Ability to capture key requirements and summarise them into management-style presentations and proposals.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
* Ability to challenge existing ways of working and drive process improvements.
  

  

Desirable Skills/Preferred Qualifications:

* Good presentation and PowerPoint skills.
* Understanding of process design, optimisation and ownership, with a focus on client outcomes and operational effectiveness.
* Exposure to product ownership models within complex, multi-stakeholder organisations.
* Understanding of regulatory requirements and controls within lending processes.
* Experience working in agile or hybrid delivery environments.
  

  

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as:

* Contributing to and influencing policies and procedures for the function, and planning, managing and consulting on multiple complex and critical strategic projects which may be business-wide.
* Providing expert advice to business and functional management and committees to influence decisions.
* Escalating breaches of policies and procedures appropriately.
* Fostering and guiding compliance, ensuring regulations are observed and relevant processes are in place to facilitate adherence.
* Focusing on the external environment, regulators or advocacy groups to both monitor and influence on behalf of Barclays, when appropriate.
* Maintaining broad and comprehensive knowledge of industry theories and practices within the relevant discipline, alongside up-to-date sector and functional knowledge and insight into external market developments and initiatives.
* Negotiating with and influencing stakeholders at a senior level, both internally and externally.
* Acting as a principal contact point for key clients and counterparts in other functions and business divisions.
* Acting as a mandated spokesperson for the function and business division.
  

  

Job location is Mumbai.

**Purpose of the role**

To develop and manage the wholesale lending products and services, collaborating with, and ensuring service standards are complied with by, business partners across the bank, including investment bankers, credit analysts, risk managers, and operations professionals, to ensure that our products meet the needs of the bank's clients and are aligned with the bank's overall strategic objectives whilst ensuring all governance, control, regulatory and legal requirements are met.

**Accountabilities**

* Development and execution of product strategy for financial products and services offered within the wholesale division. .
* Identification of investments opportunities and customer needs to create new products or enhance existing ones. .
* Management of the entire product lifecycle, including product planning, development, launch, and ongoing management, including oversight of service levels. .
* Analysis of market data to make informed decisions regarding product positioning and pricing. .
* Assessment and management of risks associated with lending products and implement risk mitigation strategies, including the operation of and attendance to governance forums. .
* Oversight of regulatory and technological change.

**Vice President Expectations**

* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Assistant Product Manager
job_description:
**Description**
---------------

Role Objective / Major Purpose of the Job To support the development and execution of marketing strategies for pharmaceutical products, drive brand growth, and coordinate with sales teams to ensure effective product promotion and market penetration. Principal Tasks & Responsibilities Key Responsibilities 1. Brand Management Assist in developing and implementing marketing strategies for assigned brands/products. Monitor product performance and recommend strategies to improve market share. Ensure consistent brand positioning across all promotional activities. 2. Marketing Campaigns Plan and execute promotional campaigns, product launches, and marketing initiatives. Develop promotional materials such as visual aids, brochures, leave-behinds, and digital content. Coordinate with design and regulatory teams for approval of marketing materials. 3. Market Research & Analysis Conduct market research to understand competitor activities, market trends, and customer needs. Analyze sales data and market insights to support marketing decisions. Prepare product performance and market analysis reports. 4. Sales Team Support Work closely with the sales and field force teams to provide marketing inputs and training. Assist in preparing product training materials and presentations. Address queries related to product positioning and promotional strategy. 5. Product Launch & Lifecycle Management Support planning and execution of new product launches. Track product lifecycle and identify opportunities for growth or repositioning. 6. Stakeholder Coordination Coordinate with internal departments such as sales, regulatory, medical, supply chain, and finance. Work with external agencies for promotional campaigns and marketing activities. 7. Budget & Reporting Assist in managing marketing budgets and promotional expenses. Prepare periodic reports on campaign effectiveness and brand performance. Key Skills & Competencies Functional Brand Management Product Lifecycle Management Market Research & Analytics Promotional Campaign Management Product Training Digital Marketing Tools Brand Awareness Strategic brand planning and execution Market research and competitor analysis Data-driven decision-making and reporting Cross-functional coordination Stakeholder management Behavioral Strong product and therapeutic knowledge Knowledge of pharma compliance and ethical marketing guidelines Creativity Communication Collaboration & Interpersonal Skills Analytical Thinking Customer Focus Result Orientation Action Orientation Tech Savvy Excellent communication and presentation skills

author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Manager
job_description:
**Overview:** We are seeking a dynamic and experienced individual to join our team as a Product Manager in the Core HCM domain . In this role, you will be responsible for leading initiatives to streamline and improve Global HR processes, ultim ately enhancing efficiency, effectiveness, and employee experience across the organization in line with company policies and compliance.

**About this role:**

We are seeking a skilled and experienced Product Manager with deep expertise in Workday Core HCM to join the People Platforms team. In this role, you will own the product strategy and continuous improvement of our Core HCM capabilities across the Hire to Retire process (excluding the Hire process, which sits with the Talent Acquisition & Attraction (TAA) team), with particularly strong focus on the Change Job business process, as well as Termination and data management. You will also need working knowledge of Workday security and integrations to understand how changes in this space ripple across the wider Workday landscape. This is a strategic, solution-oriented position where you will collaborate with global leaders and cross-functional teams—including process owners, technology, security, and support functions—to accelerate implementation timelines, manage the product lifecycle, reduce operational issues, apply prioritization frameworks, and build a transparent, high-quality product roadmap.

The role is weighted roughly 50–70% product management and 50–30% process ownership; in practice the two are heavily intertwined, and the successful candidate will move fluidly between defining what we build and defining and standardizing how the underlying HR processes work.

**Key responsibilities**

**Product**

Product Strategy & Roadmap

* Define and execute a strategic product roadmap for Workday Core HCM aligned with organizational goals and evolving market needs, with a strong emphasis on the Change Job business process, Termination, and data management across the Hire to Retire lifecycle (excluding Hire, owned by TAA).

Feature Prioritization & Backlog Management

* Collaborate with process owners, technical teams, and business stakeholders to prioritize features and enhancements based on impact, feasibility, and user feedback; own and groom the product backlog in Jira (or equivalent).

Requirements & Development Oversight

* Translate business needs into clear product requirements, well-crafted user stories, and acceptance criteria. Lead the end-to-end product development lifecycle using agile methodologies, ensuring timely and high-quality delivery.

Quality Assurance & Testing

* Partner with solution and QA teams to define test strategies—particularly for Change Job, Termination, and other core data change scenarios—and support testing efforts to ensure the reliability and performance of product releases.

Stakeholder Engagement & Product Evangelism

* Act as a trusted advisor and advocate for your products. Communicate the product vision, roadmap, and value proposition to stakeholders and end-users.

User-Centric Design & Feedback Loops

* Engage with users to gather insights, validate solutions, and drive continuous improvement through iterative feedback and data-driven decision-making.

Training & Change Enablement

* Collaborate with change management teams to develop training materials, user guides, and communication plans that support adoption and maximize product value.

Security & Integrations Awareness

* Work with security and integration teams to understand the downstream and upstream impact of Core HCM changes (e.g., Change Job, Termination, data changes) on business process security, access, and integrations, ensuring product decisions account for these implications.

**Process**

Process Design & Documentation

* Conduct comprehensive assessments of current Hire to Retire processes (excluding Hire), particularly Change Job, Termination, and related data management workflows, to identify areas for improvement and optimization.

* Develop, implement, and maintain process documentation and guidelines, ensuring these are scalable and adaptable across regions and business units, and are clearly reflected in the supporting Workday configuration.

Process Standardization

* Develop and maintain global standards for Change Job, Termination, and data management processes to enable consistency and compliance across all regions.

* Conduct regular checks to identify variances and areas for optimization, and facilitate the sharing of best practices across regions.

Process Simplification & Automation

* Use data-driven insight (including process mining where available) to identify complex, redundant, or unnecessary steps in Change Job, Termination, and data management processes, and redesign them to remove bottlenecks and reduce errors.

* Identify opportunities to automate manual tasks and evaluate technology solutions that streamline processes and enhance the employee and HR user experience.

Continuous Improvement

* Implement continuous improvement initiatives—drawing on methodologies such as Lean, Six Sigma, or Kaizen where relevant—and define metrics and KPIs to measure process performance and track progress.

Change Management & Compliance

* Lead process change management activities tied to product releases, including training, documentation, and progress monitoring.

* Ensure Change Job, Termination, and data management processes comply with relevant data privacy, security, and regulatory requirements; support audits and help implement corrective actions where gaps are identified .

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant field (preferred).

* Minimum 7 years of experience as a Digital or Software Product Manager and/or Process Owner in the HR Technology domain.

* Deep, hands-on expertise in Workday Core HCM, with demonstrated strong expertise in the Change Job business process specifically; solid working knowledge of Termination and data management processes.

* Broad working knowledge of Workday more generally, with the ability to understand how Core HCM changes interact with other modules.

* Working knowledge of Workday security (e.g., domain and business process security) and integrations, sufficient to identify downstream impacts and collaborate effectively with specialist teams.

* Strong understanding of HR processes and systems in large, global, and matrixed organizations, including the wider Hire to Retire lifecycle.

* Strong experience working with agile methodologies and tools such as Jira (or similar), including facilitating agile ceremonies (e.g., stand-ups, sprint planning, retrospectives).

* Demonstrated strength in crafting clear, well-structured user stories and acceptance criteria.

* Experience in process design, standardization, and continuous improvement; familiarity with methodologies such as Lean, Six Sigma, or Kaizen is a plus.

* Demonstrated ability to develop business cases for automation and process improvements.

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

* Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management abilities.

* Experience working with industrial or frontline organizations (e.g., retail, manufacturing, logistics ) is a plus.

* Passion for innovation and driving meaningful change in the HR tech landscape.

title: Digital Product Manager Expert - Finance Technology
job_description:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

**Job Description**

We are seeking a forward-thinking Digital Product Manager to lead the creation of AI-powered finance technology products that transform enterprise financial data into action. In this role you will define and deliver next-generation finance capabilities that include predictive modelling, trend analysis, risk identification, automated insight generation, and faster anomaly detection across the business,  
  
  
  
  
Working closely with Finance, Accounting, Product and Technology stakeholders, you will translate complex business challenges into scalable digital product solutions that reduce the time from insight to action and enable faster, data-driven decisions that improve financial performance and support profitable growth.

### **Key responsibilities**

* Define and own the product vision, roadmap, and success measures for AI-enabled finance technology products across financial management, predictive modelling, insight generation, and anomaly detection.
* Partner with Finance, Accounting, Product and Technology teams to identify high-value business problems and convert them into prioritised product outcomes, requirements, and delivery plans.
* Lead cross-functional delivery of digital products and intelligence capabilities, ensuring solutions use modern data, cloud, analytics, and AI technologies to create measurable business value.
* Translate complex financial data, trends, risks, and opportunities into user-centred products that support faster and more informed decision-making for business leaders.
* Manage stakeholder alignment across senior business and technology audiences, influencing strategy, resolving competing priorities, and maintaining clear communication on progress and outcomes.
* Monitor product performance using agreed metrics, user feedback, and business impact measures to continuously improve adoption, usability, and time from insight to action.

**Essential Skills**

  

* Minimum 15 years’ experience in Digital Product Management, leading platform or data products, from discovery through delivery and adoption.
* Evidence of delivering strategic transformation initiatives that used data, cloud, analytics, automation, or AI technologies to improve business outcomes.
* Strong Finance, Accounting, Data, Analytics, or enterprise technology domain experience, with the ability to translate complex business problems into product roadmaps and measurable outcomes.
* Experience working with senior business and technology stakeholders to prioritise product backlogs, influence decisions, and deliver outcomes across cross-functional teams.

* Ability to define product success measures and use data, user feedback, and performance indicators to assess value, adoption, and continuous improvement.
* Experience delivering AI-powered, machine learning, predictive analytics, or automated insight products within Finance, Accounting, Risk, or enterprise data environments.
* Knowledge of financial performance management, forecasting, scenario modelling, financial controls, or anomaly detection use cases.
* Experience with agile product delivery practices including discovery, roadmap planning, user story definition, backlog management, and iterative release planning.
* Exposure to enterprise data platforms, cloud-based analytics environments, business intelligence solutions, or data governance considerations.
* Product management certification, agile certification, or relevant qualification in business, finance, data, technology, or product management.

**Primary Skills**

Business Case Analyses, Digital Product Management, Product Management, Product Roadmapping, Product Strategies, Systems Thinking

**Shift Time**

**Recruiter Info**

Hiral Parag Rughanihparb@allstate.com

**About Allstate**

**Joining our team isn’t just a job — it’s an opportunity. One that takes your skills and pushes them to the next level. One that encourages you to challenge the status quo. One where you can shape the future of protection while supporting causes that mean the most to you. Joining our team means being part of something bigger – a winning team making a meaningful impact.**

The Allstate Corporation is one of the largest publicly held insurance providers in the United States. Ranked No. 84 in the 2023 Fortune 500 list of the largest United States corporations by total revenue, The Allstate Corporation owns and operates 18 companies in the United States, Canada, Northern Ireland, and India. Allstate India Private Limited, also known as Allstate India, is a subsidiary of The Allstate Corporation. The India talent center was set up in 2012 and operates under the corporation's Good Hands promise. As it innovates operations and technology, Allstate India has evolved beyond its technology functions to be the critical strategic business services arm of the corporation. With offices in Bengaluru and Pune, the company offers expertise to the parent organization’s business areas including technology and innovation, accounting and imaging services, policy administration, transformation solution design and support services, transformation of property liability service design, global operations and integration, and training and transition.

Learn more about Allstate India here.

*EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.*

We are seeking an experienced **Product Manager** to drive product roadmap, vision, and lifecycle management while collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders in a dynamic, agile environment.

**Responsibilities**

* Define and own the product roadmap, vision, and lifecycle strategy
* Lead product discovery initiatives to identify market needs and opportunities
* Manage multiple scrum teams in parallel based on business priorities
* Communicate with stakeholders to raise and address risks in a timely fashion
* Oversee the use of ADO tools to manage stories and boards
* Collaborate with development teams throughout the agile software development lifecycle, including requirements gathering, design, development, testing, deployment, and support
* Convey technical solutions and concepts to non-technical management and stakeholders
* Provide accurate estimates to support planning and commitment delivery
* Apply software engineering best practices across product management activities

**Requirements**

* 10-15 years of overall experience in IT, with a strong background in product management and product ownership
* Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science
* Expertise in SAFE and Agile methodologies, or PMP certification
* Experience running multiple scrum teams in parallel according to business needs
* Background in the Oil & Gas industry
* Knowledge of tools like ADO to manage stories and boards
* Strong knowledge of computer science fundamentals and their application in large-scale distributed systems
* Understanding of agile software development lifecycle processes, including requirements gathering, design and architecture, development, testing, deployment, and application support
* Experience working in development teams using Agile development processes (Scrum)
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the capability to convey technical solutions to non-technical people
* Skills in accurate estimating to make and keep promises
* Demonstrated ability to work and communicate effectively across various disciplines, including non-technical management

**We offer**

* Opportunity to work on technical challenges that may impact across geographies
* Vast opportunities for self-development: online university, knowledge sharing opportunities globally, learning opportunities through external certifications
* Opportunity to share your ideas on international platforms
* Sponsored Tech Talks & Hackathons
* Unlimited access to LinkedIn learning solutions
* Possibility to relocate to any EPAM office for short and long-term projects
* Focused individual development
* Benefit package:
  + Health benefits
  + Retirement benefits
  + Paid time off
  + Flexible benefits
* Forums to explore beyond work passion (CSR, photography, painting, sports, etc.)

job_description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Hyderabad, Telangana, India; Bengaluru, Karnataka, India**.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in product management or a related technical role.
* 2 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end-to-end, 0 to 1, etc).
* 2 years of experience developing/launching products/technologies within one or more of the following: Cloud, SaaS, enterprise, internal tools, or supply chain networks.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience with Quote-to-Cash, Ordering, Fulfillment or Supply Chain Product Management.
* Experience in Platform Product Management.
* Knowledge of Ordering and Fulfillment Processes and Systems for Hardware or Software.
* Strong product management, business acumen, investigative, and stakeholder management skills, with exceptional attention to detail.
* Strong problem solving, data analysis and business judgment skills.

**About the job**
-----------------

At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
  
  
In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.  
  
One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

  

The OREO (Ordering, Entitlements and Obligations) team powers Google Cloud's commercial success by managing order booking and product fulfillment orchestration. Part of GCBP (Google Cloud Business Platform), we are modernizing the Quote-to-Cash life-cycle—from ordering and provisioning to billing—ensuring data quality across Cloud's financial, sales compensation, and transaction systems. We offer a collaborative, culture focused on major architectural upgrades and high-stakes initiatives.

As a team member, you will manage the migration to Cloud's automated booking and orchestration platform, launching new agreement types, products, and Go-To-Market (GTM) motions to reshape the post-agreement experience for customers and internal teams. We provide growth opportunities, empowering Product Managers to direct high-visibility programs and strategic integrations alongside talented peers. Join us to solve tests and impact Google Cloud's commerce platform.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Lead the product roadmap for core ordering systems, modernizing and automating Google Cloud's Quote-to-Cash life-cycle across offline and online flows.
* Design and execute end-to-end orchestration workflows for product provisioning and manage platform primitives for entitlement life-cycles and usage integration metrics.
* Drive cross-functional alignment with engineering, sales operations, and boundary product groups to support commercial transaction flows and downstream systems like sales compensation, billing, and business recognition.
* Serve as the Subject Matter Expert and advocate for process/system discipline in ordering, booking, and fulfillment for your supported line of business.
* Lead end-to-end initiatives across Quote-to-Cash and GCBP overall.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

  

The OREO (Ordering, Entitlements and Obligations) team powers Google Cloud's commercial success by managing order booking and product fulfillment orchestration. Part of GCBP (Google Cloud Business Platform), we are modernizing the Quote-to-Cash life-cycle—from ordering and provisioning to billing—ensuring data quality across Cloud's financial, sales compensation, and transaction systems. We offer a collaborative, culture focused on major architectural upgrades and high-stakes initiatives.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. **Responsibilities**

* Lead the product roadmap for core ordering systems, modernizing and automating Google Cloud's Quote-to-Cash life-cycle across offline and online flows.
* Design and execute end-to-end orchestration workflows for product provisioning and manage platform primitives for entitlement life-cycles and usage integration metrics.
* Drive cross-functional alignment with engineering, sales operations, and boundary product groups to support commercial transaction flows and downstream systems like sales compensation, billing, and business recognition.
* Serve as the Subject Matter Expert and advocate for process/system discipline in ordering, booking, and fulfillment for your supported line of business.
* Lead end-to-end initiatives across Quote-to-Cash and GCBP overall.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. job_description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

**Product Manager**, **Shipping as a Service** (L24)

  
  

**About the Team and the Role**

  
  

**eBay Shipping is evolving from a marketplace capability into a reusable global platform.** Our ambition is to make eBay's shipping services available to eBay entities and subsidiaries, external marketplaces, third-party commerce and logistics platforms, and sellers operating across multiple channels.

We are looking for a customer-obsessed Senior Product Manager to own the end-to-end partner and client journey - from opportunity discovery and solution shaping through integration, launch and adoption. You will help early clients succeed while ensuring their needs are translated into scalable platform patterns rather than one-off implementations.

This role sits at the intersection of B2B product, developer experience and global go-to-market. You will work closely with eBay Shipping Product and Engineering teams, Design, Analytics, Business, Legal, Finance, Operations and partner-management teams to create a repeatable model for bringing new clients onto the platform.

  
  

**What you will Accomplish**

* Define the product strategy and roadmap for client onboarding, partner integrations and adoption of Shipping as a Service.

* Segment and prioritize target customers and use cases across eBay entities, subsidiaries, marketplaces, third-party platforms, high-volume sellers and multi-channel businesses.

* Own the complete client journey from discovery and requirements through technical integration, certification, production launch, growth and support.

* Develop repeatable integration patterns, reference journeys and onboarding playbooks that reduce time to first API call, first label and production scale.

* Partner with the Platform PM and Engineering teams to translate client needs into reusable APIs, configuration and operational capabilities.

* Shape the developer and partner experience, including documentation, onboarding, authentication and access controls, sandbox journeys, sample applications, integration checklists, and support processes.

* Work with client teams to define embedded shipping experiences that are simple, trustworthy and consistent while allowing appropriate flexibility for their customers.

* Lead cross-functional launch readiness across Product, Engineering, Business, Legal, Security, Payments, Reconciliation, Shipping Operations, Customer Support and Analytics.

* Build feedback loops with clients and partners to identify friction, prioritize improvements and continuously strengthen the platform proposition.

* Establish and own adoption metrics such as integration cycle time, activation, active clients, shipment volume, repeat usage, support contacts and partner satisfaction.

* Tell a compelling product and business story that aligns senior stakeholders around target clients, investment priorities, launch sequencing and measurable outcomes.

  
  

**What you will Bring**

* 3+ years of product management experience, ideally across B2B, B2B2C, marketplaces, SaaS, developer products or platform integrations.

* Experience taking complex integrations from early discovery through production launch and adoption.

* Strong customer-discovery skills and the ability to distinguish reusable platform needs from client-specific requests.

* A track record of designing effective onboarding, activation or partner experiences using qualitative insight and funnel data.

* Strong understanding of APIs and technical integrations, with the ability to work credibly with client and platform engineering teams.

* Excellent product judgement, prioritization and execution discipline in ambiguous, multi-stakeholder environments.

* Strong analytical mindset; comfortable defining metrics, measuring integration and adoption funnels, and using data to prioritize improvements.

* Exceptional communication and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to align senior internal leaders and external partners.

* Ability to operate globally across markets, time zones, regulatory models and different client operating contexts.

**Additional Details**

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

  

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center, and AI Hiring Guidelines.

job_description:
Position Type

Full Time

Career area

Program, Product & Project Management

Location

4/F, WeWork, Embassy GolfLinks, Karnataka, Karnātaka 560093, India

Job ID

R-96314

Become a Part of the NIKE, Inc. Team

NIKE, Inc. does more than outfit the world’s best athletes. It is a place to explore potential, obliterate boundaries and push out the edges of what can be. The company looks for people who can grow, think, dream and create. Its culture thrives by embracing diversity and rewarding imagination. The brand seeks achievers, leaders and visionaries. At NIKE, Inc. it’s about each person bringing skills and passion to a challenging and constantly evolving game.

**WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH**

This role reports to the Manager, Software Engineering, within Global Procurement Technology at the India Technology Center (ITC) in Bangalore.

The ITC team supports global procurement and corporate functions, enabling NIKE to operate efficiently and at scale across regions. As the lead technical program manager for indirect procurement, you will own the end-to-end program strategy for Source-to-Pay (S2P) solutions and coach TPMs who execute roadmaps for individual product areas.

Successful delivery and operational excellence in this role depend on close collaboration with:

* Senior TPMs, software engineers, architects, analysts, and business partners across indirect procurement products such as Coupa, Tririga, Beeline, Concur, Aravo, and related SaaS platforms
* Core ERP teams (SAP S/4HANA, ECC, and Oracle) covering accounts payable, tax, and related domains
* Engineering, security, and enterprise architecture partners
* External SaaS vendors and technology partners
  

  
  

**WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

We are seeking a seasoned technical program leader with deep expertise in procurement processes and platforms, particularly integrating sourcing and procurement SaaS with SAP (ECC and S/4HANA). The successful candidate combines hands-on S2P and P2P knowledge with proven ability to define multi-horizon roadmaps, lead TPMs, and influence senior business and technology stakeholders in a global enterprise.

  

In this role, you will own product vision and roadmap articulation, portfolio prioritization, program governance, and delivery cadence across scrum teams. You will facilitate workshops and design discussions at the portfolio level, validate requirements and solution approaches, mentor senior and junior TPMs, and partner with procurement leadership to deliver scalable, audit-ready capabilities worldwide.

  

This position is based in Bangalore, India. We welcome applications from candidates currently residing in Bangalore as well as those willing to relocate.
  
**Required Skills**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8+ years in software engineering, technical program management, or product delivery with a strong focus on procurement processes and platforms, including hands-on experience integrating multiple indirect procurement tools with SAP (ECC and S/4HANA).
* Demonstrated leadership of TPMs or cross-functional delivery teams across P2P and S2P products, SaaS-based procurement systems, and ERP master and transactional data flows.
* Expertise in integration strategy—source-to-target mapping, payload design, transformations, and patterns spanning APIs, events, batch/file, and middleware—with ability to guide architects and engineers.
* Proficiency with portfolio and delivery tools such as Jira, Confluence, and Lucid (or equivalents); experience defining prioritization frameworks and operating rhythms for global programs.
* Exceptional communication and executive presence, with the ability to synthesize complex technical and process topics for business, engineering, and vendor audiences.
* Comfort leading in a fast-paced, results-oriented, global environment with competing priorities and ambiguous problem spaces.
* Strong collaboration skills and a growth mindset: you develop others, model curiosity, and drive continuous improvement across teams and vendors.
  

**WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON**

* You will define and communicate the vision and roadmap for enterprise Source-to-Pay and procurement technology that supports Nike's global indirect procurement operations.
* You will lead portfolio-level prioritization with procurement, finance, and technology leaders—balancing demand, risk, cost, and capability—and drive decisions to clear commitments.
* You will translate strategic intent into phased delivery plans, success metrics, and well-scoped backlogs, guiding teams on out-of-the-box SaaS use versus justified extensions.
* You will mentor and develop TPMs and senior engineers on delivery execution, stakeholder engagement, and program governance.
* You will partner with ERP, security, enterprise architecture, and external SaaS vendors to align solutions with Nike standards, integration patterns, and long-term platform direction.
* You will establish program health metrics, release readiness criteria, and escalation paths so teams deliver predictably across regions.
* You will anticipate regulatory, audit, and operational needs (e.g., SOX, data residency, vendor SLAs) and embed them in roadmap planning.

NIKE, Inc. is a growth company that looks for team members to grow with it. Nike offers a generous total rewards package, casual work environment, a diverse and inclusive culture, and an electric atmosphere for professional development. No matter the location, or the role, every Nike employee shares one galvanizing mission: To bring inspiration and innovation to every athlete\* in the world.

NIKE, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability.

What You Can Expect

**OUR HIRING GAME PLAN**
------------------------

### **01 Apply**

Our teams are made up of diverse skillsets, knowledge bases, inputs, ideas and backgrounds. We want you to find your fit – review job descriptions, departments and teams to discover the role for you.

### **02 Meet a Recruiter or Take an Assessment**

If selected for a corporate role, a recruiter will reach out to start your interview process and be your main contact throughout the process. For retail roles, you’ll complete an interactive assessment that includes a chat and quizzes and takes about 10-20 minutes to complete. No matter the role, we want to learn about you – the whole you – so don’t shy away from how you approach world-class service and what makes you unique.

### **03 Interview**

Go into this stage confident by doing your research, understanding what we are looking for and being prepared for questions that are set up to learn more about you, and your background.

job_description:
**Senior Product Manager / Solutions Architect – Design Automation & AI Workflows**
===================================================================================

**Company Overview**  
Siemens EDA is a global technology leader in Electronic Design Automation software. Our software tools enable companies around the world to develop highly innovative electronic products faster and more cost-effectively. Our customers use our tools to push the boundaries of technology and physics to deliver better products in the increasingly complex world of chip, board, and system design.

**Want to Help Shape How Chips Are Designed in the Future?**

* How would you automate workflows that have traditionally required years of engineering expertise?
* How would you combine AI, optimization, and domain knowledge to solve challenging problems across analog, custom digital, and standard cell design?
* How would you help customers migrate decades of intellectual property between design environments?
* How would you create products that make engineers dramatically more productive while improving design quality?
* How would you take breakthrough ideas from concept to deployment at the world's leading semiconductor companies?

That's what we do. We're looking for people who are excited about solving difficult problems and making a meaningful impact. You'll work at the intersection of semiconductor design, AI, product strategy, and customer engagement. The ideal candidate understands complex design challenges, can translate customer needs into product requirements, and enjoys helping bring innovative technologies from concept to production.

**Responsibilities**

* Define product requirements and workflows for next-generation design automation solutions.
* Work directly with customers to understand challenges, identify opportunities, and validate proposed solutions.
* Drive product direction for technologies across analog design, standard cell design, custom digital implementation, design migration, and design automation.
* Partner closely with engineering teams to translate customer needs into product capabilities and deliverables.
* Define use cases, success metrics, benchmarks, and customer adoption strategies.
* Lead evaluations, demonstrations, customer engagements, and early-access deployments.
* Influence roadmap priorities based on market needs, customer feedback, and competitive analysis.

**Requirements**

* BS, MS, or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline.
* Experience in semiconductor design, EDA, or related technical fields.
* Experience defining solutions, workflows, or products that have been successfully delivered to users or customers.
* Experience applying automation, AI, machine learning, generative AI, or agentic AI technologies to engineering workflows.
* Strong understanding of one or more of the following domains:
  + Analog and custom IC design
  + Standard cell design and optimization
  + Physical implementation
  + Design migration and design reuse
  + Semiconductor design automation
  + Physical verification, extraction, and simulation workflows
* Experience working directly with customers to gather requirements and drive technology adoption.
* Strong communication, presentation, and collaboration skills.
* Ability to work effectively across product management, engineering, sales, and customer teams.

**Preferred Experience**

* Analog and custom IC design workflows.
* Circuit simulation, SPICE, and analog verification flows.
* DRC, LVS, parasitic extraction, and physical verification.
* OpenAccess-based design environments.
* Experience with commercial EDA platforms such as Cadence Virtuoso.
* Delivering software products used in production semiconductor design flows.
* Technical leadership and cross-functional collaboration.

We are looking for product leaders who are excited by emerging technology, enjoy solving complex problems, and want to help shape the future of semiconductor design. Success in this role requires a combination of technical depth, customer focus, business judgment, and the ability to turn innovative ideas into widely adopted solutions.

**Why us?**  
Working at Siemens Software means flexibility — choosing between working at home and the office (with state-of-the-art facilities in Bangalore and Noida) at other times is the norm here. We offer great benefits and rewards, as you'd expect from a world leader in industrial software.

A collection of over 377,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday

**EXCLUSIVE NETWORKS** | **Introduction**

Exclusive Networks is the global cybersecurity go-to-market specialist that provides partners and end-customers with a wide range of services and product portfolios. With offices in over 45 countries and the ability to serve customers in over 170 countries, we combine deep local expertise with the scale and delivery of a single global organization.

Our best-in-class vendor portfolio is carefully curated with all leading industry players. Our services range from managed security to specialist technical accreditation and training and capitalize on rapidly evolving technologies and changing business models. For more information visit www.exclusive-networks.com.

At Exclusive Networks, we are passionate about making a difference. That means delivering the best to our ecosystem, shaping a prosperous and trusted digital world, and helping our people to realize their full potential.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** | **About the role**

The Product Manager is responsible for driving profitable business growth by managing the complete sales lifecycle—from lead qualification to closure—while ensuring strong pipeline hygiene, partner engagement, and alignment with vendor expectations

This role will report to the Business Unit Head

**As the Product Manager, you will:**

1. Sales Pipeline and Funnel Management

* Develop, maintain, and manage a qualified 3X sales funnel aligned with vendor-assigned revenue targets.
* Conduct bi-weekly pipeline reviews with vendor teams to ensure alignment on progress and forecasts.
* Oversee accurate and timely deal registrations, opportunity tracking, and reporting.

2. Lead Management and Customer Engagement

* Qualify leads generated through cold outreach, inbound inquiries, and partner referrals.
* Independently present vendor solutions to prospects, involving senior or technical stakeholders only for executive-level or strategic accounts.

3. Proposal and Solution Support

* Prepare and oversee the creation of competitive quotations and proposals.
* Coordinate proof-of-concepts (POCs), demo units, and other pre-sales engagements to support solution validation.

4. Partner and Vendor Management

* Manage key stakeholders within the business line to ensure effective collaboration and execution.
* Identify, develop, and nurture Focus Partners to drive mutual growth.
* Deliver partner enablement sessions, including updates and training programs.

5. Marketing Collaboration

* Establish measurable objectives for marketing investments and initiatives.
* Collaborate with internal marketing teams and external partners to plan and execute joint campaigns effectively.

6. Certifications and Compliance

* Obtain and maintain all mandatory vendor sales certifications.
* Ensure adherence to organizational governance standards and reporting requirements.

**QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE** | **About you**

**The Product Manager :**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Business, IT, Engineering, or a related field
* Minimum 3+ years of experience in channel sales, preferably in networking or IT solutions
* Proven track record in selling solutions related to Extreme Networks products and services
* Strong understanding of solution selling and partner ecosystem management
* Experience in working with distributors, resellers, and system integrators
* Excellent presentation, negotiation, and communication skills
* Ability to manage complex sales cycles and drive revenue growth
* Self-motivated with strong relationship-building and account management skills

We are people focused and strongly believe that talent empowers us to continue our dynasty of disruption and growth in the future. Our Mission is to drive the transition to a totally trusted digital world for all people and organizations. Visit our website www.exclusive-networks.com.

job_description:
**Job Information**
-------------------

* Date Opened 27/10/2026
* Job Type Full time
* Industry Technology
* Work Experience 2-4 years
* City Noida
* Province Uttar Pradesh
* Country India
* Postal Code 201301

**Job Description**
-------------------

As a **Product Manager** at Rezo, you will own the complete product lifecycle: from understanding user needs and writing PRDs to managing design and development, launching features, and driving adoption. The ideal candidate is a systems thinker who understands internal workflows and is equally comfortable building external modules that customers interact with directly. This is a high-impact role focused on delivering exceptional experiences for enterprise clients while enabling internal teams—from Sales to Analytics—to operate efficiently and at scale.

  

**Key responsibilities:**

• Product Strategy & Execution

- Define and manage the roadmap for customer-facing modules and internal tools that support delivery and operations.

- Translate business goals and user needs into structured product features and intuitive user journeys.

- Prioritize features based on impact, dependencies, and stakeholder feedback.

  

• Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Gather inputs and drive alignment across teams such as Sales, Project Delivery, Legal, Infra, Customer Success, and Analytics.

- Partner with Engineering to deliver high-quality features on time.

  

• User-Centered Development

- Conduct deep discovery with internal stakeholders and enterprise customers to identify pain points.

- Write detailed PRDs with clear workflows, success criteria, and edge cases.

- Create wireframes or collaborate with the design team to bring concepts to life.

  

• Platform Thinking

- Build scalable systems that work across geographies, teams, and industries.

- Establish feedback loops to continuously evolve internal and external tools.

  

• Analytics & Quality

- Monitor platform metrics, customer behavior, and operational performance to identify improvement areas.

- Collaborate with analytics teams to track adoption, identify friction points, and recommend interventions.

  

### **Requirements**

Educational Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Marketing, Computer Science, or related field.

  

Experience

* 2–4 years of product management experience in B2B SaaS, preferably across platforms, internal tools, and customer-facing products.

  

Functional Skills
  
- Proven ability to write high-quality PRDs and lead cross-functional teams.

- Strong systems thinking with experience designing tools that enhance operational productivity.

- Exposure to customer lifecycle workflows, data dashboards, or service automation is a plus.

- Proficiency in JIRA, Figma, Confluence, or similar tools.

  

Behavioral Skills & Attitude

- Customer-Centric Mindset – Prioritizes customer satisfaction and proactive engagement.

- Proactive Approach – Anticipates issues and takes ownership to resolve them.

- Communication Skills – Communicates clearly and persuasively with stakeholders.

- Interpersonal Skills – Builds strong relationships and fosters trust.

* Date Opened 27/10/2026
* Job Type Full time
* Industry Technology
* Work Experience 2-4 years
* City Noida
* Province Uttar Pradesh
* Country India
* Postal Code 201301

**Job Description**
-------------------

As a **Product Manager** at Rezo, you will own the complete product lifecycle: from understanding user needs and writing PRDs to managing design and development, launching features, and driving adoption. The ideal candidate is a systems thinker who understands internal workflows and is equally comfortable building external modules that customers interact with directly. This is a high-impact role focused on delivering exceptional experiences for enterprise clients while enabling internal teams—from Sales to Analytics—to operate efficiently and at scale.

  

**Key responsibilities:**

• Product Strategy & Execution

- Define and manage the roadmap for customer-facing modules and internal tools that support delivery and operations.

- Translate business goals and user needs into structured product features and intuitive user journeys.

- Prioritize features based on impact, dependencies, and stakeholder feedback.

  

• Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Gather inputs and drive alignment across teams such as Sales, Project Delivery, Legal, Infra, Customer Success, and Analytics.

- Partner with Engineering to deliver high-quality features on time.

  

• User-Centered Development

- Conduct deep discovery with internal stakeholders and enterprise customers to identify pain points.

- Write detailed PRDs with clear workflows, success criteria, and edge cases.

- Create wireframes or collaborate with the design team to bring concepts to life.

  

• Platform Thinking

- Build scalable systems that work across geographies, teams, and industries.

- Establish feedback loops to continuously evolve internal and external tools.

  

• Analytics & Quality

- Monitor platform metrics, customer behavior, and operational performance to identify improvement areas.

- Collaborate with analytics teams to track adoption, identify friction points, and recommend interventions.

  

### **Requirements**

Educational Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Marketing, Computer Science, or related field.

  

Experience

* 2–4 years of product management experience in B2B SaaS, preferably across platforms, internal tools, and customer-facing products.

  

Functional Skills
  
- Proven ability to write high-quality PRDs and lead cross-functional teams.

- Strong systems thinking with experience designing tools that enhance operational productivity.

- Exposure to customer lifecycle workflows, data dashboards, or service automation is a plus.

- Proficiency in JIRA, Figma, Confluence, or similar tools.

  

Behavioral Skills & Attitude

- Customer-Centric Mindset – Prioritizes customer satisfaction and proactive engagement.

- Proactive Approach – Anticipates issues and takes ownership to resolve them.

- Communication Skills – Communicates clearly and persuasively with stakeholders.

- Interpersonal Skills – Builds strong relationships and fosters trust.

job_description:
Date live: 10/26/2026

Business Area: In Business BSS

Area of Expertise: Product Development & Management

Contract: Permanent

Reference Code: JR-0000133593

  

Join us as a "Product Manager” at Barclays, where you'll spearhead the evolution of our digital landscape, driving innovation and excellence. You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in the role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

To leverage data, analytical techniques and business insight to identify opportunities, solve strategic business problems and optimize customer outcomes across the Financial Assistance customer journey. This role will support data-driven decision-making by delivering insights, evaluating performance and recommending actions that balance customer, commercial and risk objectives.

  
  

To be successful as a "Product Manager", you should have experience with:

* Applying analytical and business thinking to solve complex customer, strategy and operational challenges within Financial Assistance.
* Understanding customer behavior across the financial difficulty journey, including early signs of stress, collections and recoveries.
* Translating ambiguous business problems into structured analytical approaches and actionable recommendations.
* Using SQL, Python and/or SAS to manipulate, analyze and interpret large and complex datasets.
* Conducting exploratory analysis, root cause investigations, customer segmentation and performance evaluations.
* Synthesizing data, business context and stakeholder requirements to generate impactful insights and drive strategic outcomes.
* Presenting clear, data-driven recommendations to senior management through compelling storytelling and effective communication.
* Partnering with Strategy, Operations, Risk, Product, Data and Technology teams to influence decision-making and deliver business outcomes.
* Ensuring robust data quality, governance and controls throughout the analytical lifecycle.

Desirable skillsets / good to have:

* Experience within Financial Assistance, Collections, Recoveries, Credit Risk or Retail Banking.
* Knowledge of consumer lending products and customer credit lifecycles.
* Experience with experimentation, strategy optimization and/or data science techniques.
* AI awareness and adoption, including the practical application of AI-enabled analytics.
* Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving skills.

This role will be based out of Gurugram.

**Purpose of the role**

Product Managers are responsible for the leading the strategic focus of the product(s), defining the product vision, market strategy, and competitive analysis. They think about the product's future and how it will evolve over time. They work with various teams, including marketing, engineering, operations, and sales, to ensure everyone is aligned on the product strategy. They use data and market research to inform their decisions and prioritize product features.

**Accountabilities**

* Define Product Strategy: Accountable for defining a product strategy that aligns with business vision, managing capabilities, balancing short-term with long-term goals, ensuring that products meet market demands and drive growth.
* Cross functional alignment: Leadership of cross functional relationships, working with various cross-functional teams to ensure alignment of product strategy and goals.
* Risk and Control: Accountable for overseeing product risk management, including identification of potential risks, development of strategies to mitigate those risks, and maintenance of alignment between the product management and control functions.
* Product Development Lifecycle: Own product development lifecycle, from concept to launch, ensuring efficient processes, on-time delivery, and alignment with E2E customer expectations and experience. – working with product owners to drive change objectives.
* Deliver Product Goals and Performance: Deliver clear objectives and key outcomes to steer the product vision and ensure alignment with company’s business goals, financial targets, and strategic vision, driving long-term business success.
* Data driven decisions: Monitor product performance through data-driven analysis and insights, regularly assessing progress against objectives and adjusting the strategies as needed to optimise outcomes and maximise value for both business and customer.
* Customer-Centric Focus: Drive a customer -first approach across the product vision, ensuring customer insights, feedback, behaviours, and pain points are at the core of the product strategy and decision-making process.
* Business and financial acumen: Understanding pricing models, costs structures, and ROI to make financially grounded decisions regarding product development.

**Analyst Expectations**

* To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
* Requires in-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise
* Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
* They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.
* Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area.
* Partner with other functions and business areas.
* Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.
* Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
* Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
* Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
* Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function.
* Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
* Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.
* Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
* Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
* Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

job_description:
**Senior Product Manager / Solutions Architect – Design Automation & AI Workflows**
===================================================================================

**Company Overview**  
Siemens EDA is a global technology leader in Electronic Design Automation software. Our software tools enable companies around the world to develop highly innovative electronic products faster and more cost-effectively. Our customers use our tools to push the boundaries of technology and physics to deliver better products in the increasingly complex world of chip, board, and system design.

**Want to Help Shape How Chips Are Designed in the Future?**

* How would you automate workflows that have traditionally required years of engineering expertise?
* How would you combine AI, optimization, and domain knowledge to solve challenging problems across analog, custom digital, and standard cell design?
* How would you help customers migrate decades of intellectual property between design environments?
* How would you create products that make engineers dramatically more productive while improving design quality?
* How would you take breakthrough ideas from concept to deployment at the world's leading semiconductor companies?

That's what we do. We're looking for people who are excited about solving difficult problems and making a meaningful impact. You'll work at the intersection of semiconductor design, AI, product strategy, and customer engagement. The ideal candidate understands complex design challenges, can translate customer needs into product requirements, and enjoys helping bring innovative technologies from concept to production.

**Responsibilities**

* Define product requirements and workflows for next-generation design automation solutions.
* Work directly with customers to understand challenges, identify opportunities, and validate proposed solutions.
* Drive product direction for technologies across analog design, standard cell design, custom digital implementation, design migration, and design automation.
* Partner closely with engineering teams to translate customer needs into product capabilities and deliverables.
* Define use cases, success metrics, benchmarks, and customer adoption strategies.
* Lead evaluations, demonstrations, customer engagements, and early-access deployments.
* Influence roadmap priorities based on market needs, customer feedback, and competitive analysis.

**Requirements**

* BS, MS, or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline.
* Experience in semiconductor design, EDA, or related technical fields.
* Experience defining solutions, workflows, or products that have been successfully delivered to users or customers.
* Experience applying automation, AI, machine learning, generative AI, or agentic AI technologies to engineering workflows.
* Strong understanding of one or more of the following domains:
  + Analog and custom IC design
  + Standard cell design and optimization
  + Physical implementation
  + Design migration and design reuse
  + Semiconductor design automation
  + Physical verification, extraction, and simulation workflows
* Experience working directly with customers to gather requirements and drive technology adoption.
* Strong communication, presentation, and collaboration skills.
* Ability to work effectively across product management, engineering, sales, and customer teams.

**Preferred Experience**

* Analog and custom IC design workflows.
* Circuit simulation, SPICE, and analog verification flows.
* DRC, LVS, parasitic extraction, and physical verification.
* OpenAccess-based design environments.
* Experience with commercial EDA platforms such as Cadence Virtuoso.
* Delivering software products used in production semiconductor design flows.
* Technical leadership and cross-functional collaboration.

We are looking for product leaders who are excited by emerging technology, enjoy solving complex problems, and want to help shape the future of semiconductor design. Success in this role requires a combination of technical depth, customer focus, business judgment, and the ability to turn innovative ideas into widely adopted solutions.

**Why us?**  
Working at Siemens Software means flexibility — choosing between working at home and the office (with state-of-the-art facilities in Bangalore and Noida) at other times is the norm here. We offer great benefits and rewards, as you'd expect from a world leader in industrial software.

A collection of over 377,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday
