title: Senior Digital Product Manager
job_description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

**Description:**  
We are seeking a dynamic and results-oriented **Sr Digital Product** to lead product development of new AI-driven self-service experiences in the voice channel to support Optum Behavioral Health customers. This role will manage the full lifecycle of a specific product or service, from strategy and development to launch and end-of-life. The successful candidate will play a critical role in driving product vision and strategy, leveraging market insights to identify new opportunities, and ensuring optimal product performance to meet customer and market needs. This role involves close collaboration with cross-functional teams and stakeholders to drive innovation, deliver exceptional customer value, and achieve performance goals. Candidates with experience in generative AI, data-driven decision-making, and advanced reporting will be solidly preferred.

This role will lead the product development for self-service voice bot solutions that leverage new Generative AI technologies to create best-in-class customer experiences.

**Primary Responsibilities**

**Product Strategy & Voice AI Innovation**

* Define and execute the product vision, roadmap, and long-term strategy for Conversational AI and Voice Bot solutions.
* Identify opportunities to leverage Voice AI, Generative AI, Natural Language Processing (NLP), Speech Recognition, and Speech Analytics technologies to improve customer experiences and operational efficiency.
* Conduct market research and competitive analysis to stay current with advancements in voice automation, conversational AI, and customer engagement technologies.

**Voice Bot Product Lifecycle Management**

* Lead the end-to-end product lifecycle of Voice Bot and Conversational AI products from ideation, business case development, implementation, enhancement, and retirement.
* Gather business requirements and translate them into product features, user stories, and technical specifications.
* Collaborate closely with engineering, UX, operations, data science, and business stakeholders to drive successful product delivery.

**Conversational AI & Generative AI Integration**

* Partner with AI/ML teams to design, implement, and optimize voice bot capabilities including intent recognition, dialogue management, speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and generative AI-powered conversations.
* Drive adoption of emerging Generative AI technologies to enhance self-service capabilities, customer engagement, and agent-assist solutions.
* Evaluate and implement AI-driven features that improve containment rates, customer satisfaction, and operational outcomes.

**Performance Monitoring & Analytics**

* Define and monitor KPIs such as containment rate, task completion rate, call deflection, customer satisfaction (CSAT), intent accuracy, automation rates, and financial performance.
* Develop dashboards and reporting frameworks to measure product success and identify optimization opportunities.
* Leverage voice analytics, conversational analytics, and customer insights to continuously improve product performance.

**Customer Experience & Voice Journey Optimization**

* Act as the voice of the customer by analyzing customer behavior, call drivers, user feedback, and interaction data.
* Design and optimize conversational journeys that deliver seamless customer experiences across voice and digital channels.
* Validate product features through user testing and ongoing feedback loops.

**Financial Ownership & Business Value**

* Develop business cases, ROI models, cost-benefit analyses, and investment proposals for voice automation initiatives.
* Partner with business leaders to establish measurable outcomes and value realization plans.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Build strong relationships with stakeholders across business, operations, technology, customer service, and external partners.
* Present product strategy, roadmap updates, performance metrics, risks, and opportunities to leadership teams.
* Act as a Voice AI product champion and advocate across the organization.

**Required Qualifications**

* 4+ years of Product Management experience with ownership of AI, Conversational AI, Voice Bot, Chatbot, Contact Center, or Customer Experience products.
* Hands-on experience delivering Voice Bot or Conversational AI solutions in enterprise environments.
* Strong understanding of Voice AI technologies, including:
  + Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR)
  + Natural Language Understanding (NLU)
  + Natural Language Processing (NLP)
  + Text-to-Speech (TTS)
  + Speech Analytics
  + Large Language Models (LLMs) and Generative AI
* Experience defining voice bot conversational flows, intent architecture, dialogue management, and customer journeys.
* Experience building business cases, ROI assessments, and value realization frameworks.
* Strong analytical and data-driven decision-making skills.
* Experience working in Agile product delivery environments.
* Excellent communication, presentation, stakeholder management, and leadership skills.
* Experience partnering with engineering and AI/ML teams to launch AI-driven customer-facing products.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working with Contact Center technologies including IVR, CCaaS, Genesys, Five9, NICE, Avaya, or Cisco.
* Experience building both Voice Bots and Chatbots.
* Experience with Conversational Analytics and Speech Analytics platforms.
* Experience with Aha! and Rally.
* Experience within Optum, Healthcare, Behavioral Health, or Healthcare Contact Center domains.
* Experience integrating Generative AI capabilities into customer service and support workflows.

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

This role will manage the full lifecycle of a specific product or service, from strategy and development to launch and end-of-life. The successful candidate will play a critical role in driving product vision and strategy, leveraging market insights to identify new opportunities, and ensuring optimal product performance to meet customer and market needs. This role involves close collaboration with cross-functional teams and stakeholders to drive innovation, deliver exceptional customer value, and achieve performance goals. Candidates with experience in generative AI, data-driven decision-making, and advanced reporting will be solidly preferred.

This role will lead the product development for self-service voice bot solutions that leverage new Generative AI technologies to create best-in-class customer experiences.

**Primary Responsibilities**

**Product Strategy & Voice AI Innovation**

* Define and execute the product vision, roadmap, and long-term strategy for Conversational AI and Voice Bot solutions.
* Identify opportunities to leverage Voice AI, Generative AI, Natural Language Processing (NLP), Speech Recognition, and Speech Analytics technologies to improve customer experiences and operational efficiency.
* Conduct market research and competitive analysis to stay current with advancements in voice automation, conversational AI, and customer engagement technologies.

**Voice Bot Product Lifecycle Management**

* Lead the end-to-end product lifecycle of Voice Bot and Conversational AI products from ideation, business case development, implementation, enhancement, and retirement.
* Gather business requirements and translate them into product features, user stories, and technical specifications.
* Collaborate closely with engineering, UX, operations, data science, and business stakeholders to drive successful product delivery.

**Conversational AI & Generative AI Integration**

* Partner with AI/ML teams to design, implement, and optimize voice bot capabilities including intent recognition, dialogue management, speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and generative AI-powered conversations.
* Drive adoption of emerging Generative AI technologies to enhance self-service capabilities, customer engagement, and agent-assist solutions.
* Evaluate and implement AI-driven features that improve containment rates, customer satisfaction, and operational outcomes.

**Performance Monitoring & Analytics**

* Define and monitor KPIs such as containment rate, task completion rate, call deflection, customer satisfaction (CSAT), intent accuracy, automation rates, and financial performance.
* Develop dashboards and reporting frameworks to measure product success and identify optimization opportunities.
* Leverage voice analytics, conversational analytics, and customer insights to continuously improve product performance.

**Customer Experience & Voice Journey Optimization**

* Act as the voice of the customer by analyzing customer behavior, call drivers, user feedback, and interaction data.
* Design and optimize conversational journeys that deliver seamless customer experiences across voice and digital channels.
* Validate product features through user testing and ongoing feedback loops.

**Financial Ownership & Business Value**

* Develop business cases, ROI models, cost-benefit analyses, and investment proposals for voice automation initiatives.
* Partner with business leaders to establish measurable outcomes and value realization plans.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Build strong relationships with stakeholders across business, operations, technology, customer service, and external partners.
* Present product strategy, roadmap updates, performance metrics, risks, and opportunities to leadership teams.
* Act as a Voice AI product champion and advocate across the organization.

**Required Qualifications**

* 4+ years of Product Management experience with ownership of AI, Conversational AI, Voice Bot, Chatbot, Contact Center, or Customer Experience products.
* Hands-on experience delivering Voice Bot or Conversational AI solutions in enterprise environments.
* Strong understanding of Voice AI technologies, including:
  + Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR)
  + Natural Language Understanding (NLU)
  + Natural Language Processing (NLP)
  + Text-to-Speech (TTS)
  + Speech Analytics
  + Large Language Models (LLMs) and Generative AI
* Experience defining voice bot conversational flows, intent architecture, dialogue management, and customer journeys.
* Experience building business cases, ROI assessments, and value realization frameworks.
* Strong analytical and data-driven decision-making skills.
* Experience working in Agile product delivery environments.
* Excellent communication, presentation, stakeholder management, and leadership skills.
* Experience partnering with engineering and AI/ML teams to launch AI-driven customer-facing products.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working with Contact Center technologies including IVR, CCaaS, Genesys, Five9, NICE, Avaya, or Cisco.
* Experience building both Voice Bots and Chatbots.
* Experience with Conversational Analytics and Speech Analytics platforms.
* Experience with Aha! and Rally.
* Experience within Optum, Healthcare, Behavioral Health, or Healthcare Contact Center domains.
* Experience integrating Generative AI capabilities into customer service and support workflows.

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

author: Hiring Manager
title: Associate Product Manager - AI
job_description:
**SOVOS**

**Associate Product Manager (AI-First)**
========================================

Product Management·Full-Time·India

**Build Your Future With Us**

The digitization of tax compliance is fundamentally changing global commerce and how businesses need to operate and grow. Governments now have real-time visibility into business data, creating new challenges and new opportunities for organizations around the world. At Sovos, we're transforming tax compliance from a business requirement into a driver of growth through AI-powered technology that delivers the accurate, real-time insights businesses need to make smarter decisions.

We're solving more than today's tax compliance challenges. We're helping reshape global economies by enabling organizations to navigate increasingly complex and rapidly changing regulatory environments with confidence – and helping communities thrive.

AI is accelerating what's possible, enabling tax and technology professionals to more effectively drive critical regulatory decisions. That's where Sovos excels, combining intelligent technology with human expertise to help customers stay ahead of change.

Don't worry if you don't check every box. We're focused on hiring great people, not perfect resumes. It's less about what you've done elsewhere and more about what you're capable of doing here.

**THE ROLE**

At Sovos, we're looking for an Associate Product Manager who will support product strategy and execution for a product area whilst taking on Product Owner responsibilities day to day. AI fluency is a core part of this role. You'll own the backlog, write sprint-ready stories, and leverage AI tools daily to research, analyse, draft, and prototype faster and more effectively. This is a global posting for India.

*More specifically, you will:*

* Own and prioritise the product backlog; keep it groomed two sprints ahead and write Jira stories with clear user story, context, acceptance criteria (Given/When/Then), and explicit out-of-scope details.
* Run sprint planning, refinement, and demos with engineering, QA, and design; accept or reject delivered work against acceptance criteria and coordinate UAT and release readiness.
* Support the Senior Product Manager on roadmaps, PRDs, and business cases; analyse usage data, support tickets, and customer feedback to identify problems worth solving.
* Work with customer success and sales to turn customer requests into validated requirements; track delivery, risks, and dependencies and report status clearly and honestly.
* Use AI tools (Claude or similar) daily for research, synthesis, drafting PRDs and stories, and analysing data; build repeatable AI workflows such as story-drafting templates or connected tools to save team time.
* Turn ideas into clickable prototypes or small internal tools using AI-assisted design or coding tools; demonstrate AI product sense by understanding LLM limits and specifying AI features with evaluation criteria and fallback behaviour.

**WHAT YOU BRING TO SOVOS**

* You've built solid experience (typically 2–3 years) in product, business analysis, or product ownership, with prior hands-on experience as both a Product Owner and in a product management role.
* Working knowledge of Agile/Scrum and Jira (epics, stories, sprints, boards); you're comfortable managing backlogs and running agile ceremonies.
* Clear, concise written communication skills; you can write acceptance criteria an engineer cannot misread and deliver status updates that are honest and actionable.
* Comfortable with data: you can read a dashboard and use analytics tools to answer product questions; you bring an ownership mindset and follow through without being chased.
* AI fluency is essential: you use AI tools daily, write structured prompts, catch hallucinations and weak reasoning, and understand data-privacy risks; you can show real examples of building AI workflows, rapid prototyping, and responsible AI use with company-approved tools.
* Domain knowledge in tax, compliance, or fintech is a plus, as is experience with UI prototyping tools, design systems, or evaluating and shipping AI-powered features.
* Due to client contractual obligations, the successful candidate will be asked to clear a background check upon hire.

**THE PROCESS**

We believe in a transparent and comprehensive hiring process. Here's what you might expect:

**1**

**Pre-Employment Assessment**

Regionally specific assessments we use to mitigate bias and give every applicant a fair shot.

**2**

**Video Interview**

A chance to meet as many qualified applicants as possible and get to know you beyond your resume.

**3**

**Meeting with a Recruiter**

A conversation to talk through the role, your experience, and your goals.

**4**

**Live Interviews with the Hiring Team**

Meet the people you'll work with and dig into the day-to-day of the role.

**LIFE AT SOVOS**

The tools to enhance your life - because we want you to enjoy your life outside of work and inside!

* Global Mentoring Programs
* AI Tools and Technology from Day 1
* Continuous Learning and Development
* Language Learning Support
* Global Employee Recognition Platform and Programs
* Global Parental Leave Policy
* Comprehensive Health Insurance (Day 1, company paid)
* Life and Accidental Insurance (company paid)
* Hybrid Work Arrangement
* Annual Health Check-up

**Equal Opportunity Employer**  
Sovos is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing an environment that celebrates diversity and where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and employees. We do not discriminate against race, colour, religions, national origin, age, sex, marital status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic provided by law. At Sovos, all employees are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work.

**Company Background**
----------------------

Sovos is transforming tax compliance from a business requirement to a force for growth. Our flagship product, the Sovos Compliance Cloud platform, enables businesses to identify, determine, and report on every tax obligation across the globe. **SOVOS**

**Associate Product Manager (AI-First)**
========================================

Product Management·Full-Time·India

**Build Your Future With Us**

The digitization of tax compliance is fundamentally changing global commerce and how businesses need to operate and grow. Governments now have real-time visibility into business data, creating new challenges and new opportunities for organizations around the world. At Sovos, we're transforming tax compliance from a business requirement into a driver of growth through AI-powered technology that delivers the accurate, real-time insights businesses need to make smarter decisions.

We're solving more than today's tax compliance challenges. We're helping reshape global economies by enabling organizations to navigate increasingly complex and rapidly changing regulatory environments with confidence – and helping communities thrive.

AI is accelerating what's possible, enabling tax and technology professionals to more effectively drive critical regulatory decisions. That's where Sovos excels, combining intelligent technology with human expertise to help customers stay ahead of change.

Don't worry if you don't check every box. We're focused on hiring great people, not perfect resumes. It's less about what you've done elsewhere and more about what you're capable of doing here.

**THE ROLE**

At Sovos, we're looking for an Associate Product Manager who will support product strategy and execution for a product area whilst taking on Product Owner responsibilities day to day. AI fluency is a core part of this role. You'll own the backlog, write sprint-ready stories, and leverage AI tools daily to research, analyse, draft, and prototype faster and more effectively. This is a global posting for India.

*More specifically, you will:*

* Own and prioritise the product backlog; keep it groomed two sprints ahead and write Jira stories with clear user story, context, acceptance criteria (Given/When/Then), and explicit out-of-scope details.
* Run sprint planning, refinement, and demos with engineering, QA, and design; accept or reject delivered work against acceptance criteria and coordinate UAT and release readiness.
* Support the Senior Product Manager on roadmaps, PRDs, and business cases; analyse usage data, support tickets, and customer feedback to identify problems worth solving.
* Work with customer success and sales to turn customer requests into validated requirements; track delivery, risks, and dependencies and report status clearly and honestly.
* Use AI tools (Claude or similar) daily for research, synthesis, drafting PRDs and stories, and analysing data; build repeatable AI workflows such as story-drafting templates or connected tools to save team time.
* Turn ideas into clickable prototypes or small internal tools using AI-assisted design or coding tools; demonstrate AI product sense by understanding LLM limits and specifying AI features with evaluation criteria and fallback behaviour.

**WHAT YOU BRING TO SOVOS**

* You've built solid experience (typically 2–3 years) in product, business analysis, or product ownership, with prior hands-on experience as both a Product Owner and in a product management role.
* Working knowledge of Agile/Scrum and Jira (epics, stories, sprints, boards); you're comfortable managing backlogs and running agile ceremonies.
* Clear, concise written communication skills; you can write acceptance criteria an engineer cannot misread and deliver status updates that are honest and actionable.
* Comfortable with data: you can read a dashboard and use analytics tools to answer product questions; you bring an ownership mindset and follow through without being chased.
* AI fluency is essential: you use AI tools daily, write structured prompts, catch hallucinations and weak reasoning, and understand data-privacy risks; you can show real examples of building AI workflows, rapid prototyping, and responsible AI use with company-approved tools.
* Domain knowledge in tax, compliance, or fintech is a plus, as is experience with UI prototyping tools, design systems, or evaluating and shipping AI-powered features.
* Due to client contractual obligations, the successful candidate will be asked to clear a background check upon hire.

**THE PROCESS**

We believe in a transparent and comprehensive hiring process. Here's what you might expect:

**1**

**Pre-Employment Assessment**

Regionally specific assessments we use to mitigate bias and give every applicant a fair shot.

**2**

**Video Interview**

A chance to meet as many qualified applicants as possible and get to know you beyond your resume.

**3**

**Meeting with a Recruiter**

A conversation to talk through the role, your experience, and your goals.

**4**

**Live Interviews with the Hiring Team**

Meet the people you'll work with and dig into the day-to-day of the role.

The tools to enhance your life - because we want you to enjoy your life outside of work and inside!

* Global Mentoring Programs
* AI Tools and Technology from Day 1
* Continuous Learning and Development
* Language Learning Support
* Global Employee Recognition Platform and Programs
* Global Parental Leave Policy
* Comprehensive Health Insurance (Day 1, company paid)
* Life and Accidental Insurance (company paid)
* Hybrid Work Arrangement

title: Product Manager Intern
job_description:
**Revvity**

Revvity is a developer and provider of end-to-end solutions designed to help scientists, researchers, and clinicians solve the world’s greatest health challenges. We pair the enthusiasm of an industry disruptor with the experience of a longtime leader. Our team of 11,000+ colleagues from around the globe are vital to our success and the reason we’re able to push boundaries in pursuit of better human health.

Find your future at Revvity.

**Ready to RiseUp?**

Through Revvity's RiseUp Internship Program, students and recent graduates gain hands-on experience, work on meaningful projects, and build skills for future success. With dedicated support and opportunities to learn, collaborate, and grow, our interns make an impact from day one. Click here to learn more

**Job Application Process**

1) Review the Job Description in detail

**2) Complete the mandatory questionnaire**https://forms.cloud.microsoft/r/agdKBU4dTM (opens in new window)

3) Submit the application on Workday

  
  

Only candidates who complete the questionnaire and apply for Job on workday will be considered for further evaluation.

  
  

Revvity is looking for a Product Manager Intern.

About you:

You have a curious nature and keep abreast of new developments or ideas gaining momentum in the business. You want to know how and why people use technology and understand how they imagine better ways of working. You interject yourselves into the conversation to ask questions that help others clarify any problems, assumptions and risks. You are outgoing, a people’s person, can put people at ease and are easy to talk to. You are curious and want to help your team answer their toughest questions by learning from others and working together.

Requirements:

* Strong interest in artificial intelligence and its practical applications in business

* Basic understanding of machine learning concepts and AI technologies

* Engaging with UX designers, UX researchers, developers and stakeholders to define and document clear product requirements

* Prioritizing and planning features based on company and stakeholder priorities and business values

* Distilling very technical concepts to business colleagues and vice versa

* Presenting information to others (e.g., to the design team/business stakeholders)

* Define and track success metrics

* Work with software engineering teams on bug triage and requirements

* You’re open to rolling up your sleeves and doing a bit of end-user research and testing as needed, to make the team and product a success

* Ability to effectively communicate in both oral and written English

Some of the other things we care about:

* Worked previously on an AI based product either as a PM or developer

* You are able to empathize with our end-users and are interested in doing some research.

* Using analytical tools and conducting product-related analyses to produce actionable insights and communicate findings

* Knowledge of user-centered design methodologies

* Believe that discussion, inclusivity and transparency result in better products

* Are eager to learn from your team and others. We value making each other successful!

* A willingness to try new things and a love of learning

* You’re a go-getter, with a keen desire to get things done

Using the “OCEAN” model which stands for Openness, Conscientiousness, Extraversion, Agreeableness and Neuroticism, we’re looking for the following personality traits:

Openness – The ability to take on new challenges and learn new things.

Conscientiousness – The ability to work independently and deliver high-quality work.

Extraversion – The ability to communicate directly with customers and users, and to present your work clearly and effectively to different stakeholders as needed.

Agreeableness – Be kind and thoughtful. We value people who are respectful of others and who are willing to jump in and help where and when needed.

Neuroticism – Although we try and minimize stress levels, there will be deadlines to meet. Plans can change, so the ability to pivot and adapt to changing priorities will be important.

You will work closely with backend engineering, the SAP team, operations, and business stakeholders to deliver it.

**Key Responsibilities**

**WMS Product Ownership**

* Own the product roadmap for operations and the Warehouse Management System (WMS) workflows used by warehouse teams, prioritised by business impact.
* Translate operational problems into clear Product Requirement Documents, use cases, and acceptance criteria for engineering and QA.
* Own product work on inward, outward, cross dock, throughput, audits, inventory, driving each from problem identification to closure.
* Partner with backend engineering to design, build, and roll out new features, and drive adoption with operations teams.
* Identify workflow gaps and inefficiencies on the ground, then define structured improvements that scale.
* Act as the single owner for the WMS charter, including cross-functional escalations and stakeholder communication.

**ERP Systems (SAP)**

* Own the integration and data consistency between the WMS and SAP for sales, inventory, stock movement, and reconciliation flows.
* Work with the SAP team, engineering, finance, and operations to debug system-level discrepancies and drive root causes to closure.
* Define, validate, and track the impact of SAP-related product changes on the WMS and on financial accuracy.
* Ensure SAP stays the reliable financial record for WMS inventory and movements.

**Business Impact and Execution**

* Define success metrics for every initiative and track their impact after launch.
* Use data to monitor warehouse health, surface insights, and drive data-informed product decisions.
* Run regular reviews with engineering and business teams to keep delivery on track and priorities clear.

**Must-Have Skills and Requirements**

* 3 to 6 years of experience in a product management role.
* BE / B.Tech from a reputed institute. MBA is a plus but not mandatory.
* Strong product fundamentals, including the ability to write clear PRDs and use cases, prioritise by impact, and ship in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities.
* Some exposure to WMS, DC operations, or SAP, with the ability to quickly learn how inventory and sales data flow across systems.
* Solid data analysis fundamentals and the ability to understand discrepancies across systems.
* Strong verbal and written communication and stakeholder management skills across product, engineering, operations, and finance teams.
* High ownership mindset with the ability to drive a problem from identification to resolution.

**Good-to-Have Skills**

* Hands-on experience with Warehouse Management Systems and distribution center operations such as inbound, storage, and outbound flows.
* Experience with SAP or a similar enterprise ERP.
* Working knowledge of SQL and comfort querying datasets in a cloud warehouse such as BigQuery.
* Hands-on experience with BI or data visualization tools such as Looker, Tableau, or Metabase.
* Exposure to inventory management, e-commerce fulfilment, or quick-commerce operations.

**What You Will Gain**

* End-to-end ownership of a business-critical WMS charter, from roadmap to impact.
* A role at the intersection of product, supply chain, and technology, with real influence on the roadmap.
* Deep exposure to SAP and ERP integration across a high-volume e-commerce supply chain.
* A clear growth path toward Senior Product Manager.

Founded in 2011, Purplle has emerged as one of India’s premier omnichannel beauty destinations, redefining the way millions shop for beauty. With 1,000+ brands, 60,000+ products, and over 7 million monthly active users, Purplle has built a powerhouse platform that seamlessly blends online and offline experiences.

Expanding its footprint in 2022, Purplle introduced 6,000+ offline touchpoints and launched 100+ stores, strengthening its presence beyond digital. Beyond hosting third-party brands, Purplle has successfully scaled its own D2C powerhouses—FACES CANADA, Good Vibes, Carmesi, Purplle, and NY Bae—offering trend-driven, high-quality beauty essentials.

What sets Purplle apart is its technology driven hyper-personalized shopping experience. By curating detailed user personas, enabling virtual makeup trials, and delivering tailored product recommendations based on personality, search intent, and purchase behavior, Purplle ensures a unique, customer-first approach.

In 2022, Purplle achieved unicorn status, becoming India’s 102nd unicorn, backed by an esteemed group of investors including ADIA, Kedaara, Premji Invest, Sequoia Capital India, JSW Ventures, Goldman Sachs, Verlinvest, Blume Ventures, and Paramark Ventures.

With a 3,000+ strong team and an unstoppable vision, Purplle is set to lead the charge in India’s booming beauty landscape, revolutionizing the way the nation experiences beauty.

title: Product Manager - Cash Management Services| Mumbai
job_description:
Job Description
  

To design and develop product strategies for the Transaction Banking franchise for all set of clients. Assess current market and analyze new trends in the industry with peer interaction. Analyze current product portfolio and enhance as per the regulatory environment, at the same time improving the existing cash management offering.

  
Responsibilities
  

Managerial Responsibilities:

Provide product solutions and recommendations aligned with business requirements, internal policies, regulatory guidelines and risk management frameworks for MSME, SME and WSB clients.

Functional Responsibilities:

* Manage and enhance Cash Management Services (CMS) products across payments, collections and transaction banking solutions.
* Drive product strategy and development for paper-based instruments including drafts, cheque printing, and dividend disbursement services.
* Manage digital payment solutions including RTGS, NEFT, IMPS, UPI and collection solutions such as physical and e-NACH mandates.
* Oversee statutory payments, utility bill payments, escrow accounts, TRA accounts and capital market transaction solutions.
* Develop and implement API-based payment solutions, Host-to-Host integrations and SFTP-based transaction banking capabilities.
* Engage with internal stakeholders across Business, Operations, Technology, Risk, Compliance, Legal and Credit functions for product enhancements and new product launches.
* Manage service provider and fintech partnerships and evaluate new technology partnerships to strengthen product capabilities.
* Drive reporting, reconciliation, governance and risk management capabilities across transaction banking products.
* Review existing processes and initiate product, process and technology enhancements to improve customer experience and operational efficiency.
* Assess market trends, competitor offerings and emerging transaction banking opportunities and recommend product improvements.

  
Qualifications
  

Experience Range: 5 to 8 years

Qualifications: Graduation/Post Graduation

title: Product Manager
job_description:
**Job Title: Product Manager**

**Location: Gurgaon, Onsite**

**Interview: Virtual**

**Experience: 8-12 Years**

**Employment Type: Full-Time**

**Budget: 25 LPA, Flexible**

**Local to NCR, Immediate Joiner (Serving Notice Only)**

**Preferred Previous MNC Exp**

Key Responsibilities

* Own and manage the product backlog, ensuring features, initiatives, and user stories are clearly defined, refined, and prioritized.

* Define product roadmaps and priorities aligned with HNW (High Net Worth) business objectives and technology strategy.

* Collaborate with Business, Product, Technology, and other stakeholders to understand requirements, dependencies, and expected outcomes.

* Translate business needs and opportunities into actionable product requirements and measurable outcomes.

* Lead backlog refinement and prioritization in collaboration with Business Analysts, Product Owners, Technology teams, and Agile squads.

* Drive Agile execution and delivery by ensuring clarity of scope, acceptance criteria, priorities, and business outcomes.

* Facilitate stakeholder discussions to resolve competing priorities, requirements, and delivery dependencies.

* Track and communicate product progress, risks, dependencies, and key decisions to relevant stakeholders.

* Identify process improvement opportunities and establish meaningful metrics to measure product effectiveness and delivery performance.

* Partner with technology teams throughout solution design, development, testing, implementation, and post-production stabilization.

* Ensure end-to-end validation of delivered capabilities against business requirements and expected outcomes.

* Provide regular product updates, insights, and recommendations to senior stakeholders and leadership.

* Drive continuous improvement by incorporating feedback and lessons learned into future product planning and delivery.

Must-Have Skills

1. Life / Wealth Insurance Domain  
2. Product Backlog Management  
3. Stakeholder Management & Collaboration  
4. Agile Execution & Product Delivery  
5. Process Improvement & Metrics

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Graduate degree in B.E. / B.Tech. from a reputed university.

* 8–12 years of relevant professional experience.

* **Strong experience in Life Insurance or Wealth Insurance is mandatory.**

* Proven experience in Product Management, product delivery, backlog management, or a closely related role.

* Experience working in Agile environments with cross-functional business and technology teams.

* Agile/Product Management certification such as CSPO, PSPO, SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager, or equivalent is preferred.

Pay: ₹2,000,000.00 - ₹2,500,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Product Manager - Fraud and ID Agent
job_description:
**Company Description**

Experian is a global data and technology company, powering opportunities for people and businesses around the world. We operate across a range of markets, from financial services to healthcare, automotive, agribusiness, insurance, and many more. Experian invests in people and new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data. We have an amazing team of 25,200 people in 32 countries.

Our uniqueness is that we celebrate yours. Experian's people first, inclusive and purpose driven culture is multi award-winning; World's Best Workplaces™ 2025 (Fortune Global Top 25), Great Place To Work™ in 26 countries to name a few.

Check out Experian Life on social or explore our Careers Site (experian.com/careers) to understand why.

 **Job Description**

As Senior Product Manager, you will lead product strategy and delivery across the Fraud and ID Agent Initiative, from the current MVP through the roadmap toward a scalable, production-ready capability. You will connect client and analyst needs with fraud expertise, data science, engineering, platform, legal, compliance, and AI governance partners. You will own the product outcomes, priorities, and decisions that keep the program useful, safe, and deliverable.

What you will do

* **Set product direction.** Define the product vision, and measurable outcomes for fraud and identity capabilities, balancing the near-term pilot with a reusable longer-term product.
* **Lead discovery with users and partners.** Work with the Brazil pilot partner and fraud specialists to understand analyst workflows, emerging fraud patterns, data needs, and what makes a recommendation actionable and.
* **Coordinate global delivery.** Align the Brazil business and data team with India-based engineering, architecture and platform teams, and partner stakeholders. Establish clear ownership, resolve blockers, and maintain a operating cadence across teams.
* **Guide responsible use of data and AI.** Partner on data access, privacy, security, AI governance, model quality, explainability, auditability, and controls. The current design uses rules and statistical methods to detect patterns, then uses an LLM to explain findings and draft recommendations.
* **Measure product performance.** Define how the team will evaluate detection quality, time to analyst review, fraud outcomes, recommendation usefulness, analyst adoption, and operational impact. Establish validation plans before expanding beyond the pilot.
* **Build the next-phase roadmap.** Use evidence from the pilot to prioritize production readiness, broader data coverage, a purpose-built analyst experience, and future client or regional expansion.
* You will report to the Senior Director of Product Management
* You will have to WFO 2 days a week as its Hybrid working

  
**Qualifications**  

* You are required to have 8+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex, data-intensive products from discovery through launch and iteration.
* Experience in fraud, identity, payments, financial services, risk decisioning, or a closely related domain.
* Work closely with engineering and data science on data pipelines, model or rules-based systems, integrations, experimentation, and production constraints.
* Strong product judgment: you can turn an ambiguous problem into a focused roadmap, make trade-offs explicit, and connect delivery to customer and business outcomes.
* Experience leading cross-functional teams and influencing senior stakeholders across regions, functions, and organizational boundaries.

**Preferred experience**

* Building or scaling AI/ML-enabled products, especially human-reviewed decision support or agentic workflows.
* Working with sensitive customer data, privacy or compliance reviews, model governance, and audit requirements.
* Launching products with international teams, pilot partners, or multi-client platforms.

  
**Additional Information**

Our uniqueness is that we celebrate yours. Experian's culture and people are important differentiators. We take our people agenda very seriously and focus on what matters; DEI, work/life balance, development, authenticity, collaboration, wellness, reward & recognition, volunteering... the list goes on. Experian's people first approach is award-winning; World's Best Workplaces™ 2024 (Fortune Global Top 25), Great Place To Work™ in 24 countries, and Glassdoor Best Places to Work 2024 to name a few. Check out Experian Life on social or our Careers Site and Glassdoor to understand why.

Experian is also proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know at the earliest opportunity.

Recruitment Fraud Awareness - Experian's recruitment process is conducted only through authorised channels. Recruitment communications will only be sent from an @experian.com email address. Experian will never ask candidates to make any payment as part of an application, interview, assessment, onboarding, or recruitment process. To apply for roles or verify opportunities, please visit experian.com/careers.

BenefitsExperian care for employee's work life balance, health, safety and wellbeing. In support of this endeavor, we offer best-in-class family well-being benefits, enhanced medical benefits and paid time off.

Experian Careers - Creating a better tomorrow together

Find out what its like to work for Experian by clicking here

**Job Description:**

**About Us**

At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
  
Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.
  
We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths - whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.
  
Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role-specific responsibilities and business needs.
  
At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!

**Global Business Services**

Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.

Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.

In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.

  
  

**Process Overview:**

Global Banking & Markets division serves mid- to large-sized corporations and institutional clients worldwide. It is comprised of Business Banking, Global Commercial Banking, Global Corporate & Investment Banking, Global Markets and Wholesale Credit. Aligned with these client-facing groups are Global Capital Markets and Global Research. Global Banking and Markets Technology provides end-to-end technology solutions for Global Markets and banking businesses including Equities, Prime Brokerage, Interest Rates, Currencies, Commodities, Derivatives, Structured Products, Commercial Card, Cash Management, Payments, Sales, Servicing and Fulfillment. Across all these products, solutions include architecture, design, development, change management, implementation and support using various enterprise technologies.

**Job Description:**

Product owner contributes to the development of the US Wires high-value payment system. Responsible for maximizing the value delivered by the Wires Modernization product and ensuring alignment with business objectives. Define and communicate the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Wires Modernization initiative. Work closely with stakeholders to understand business needs, challenges, and priorities, translating them into actionable product requirements. Collaborate with the Product Manager within a scaled Agile framework to ensure alignment with broader program and organizational goals. Own and prioritize the product backlog, ensuring the highest-value work is delivered first. Partner with the development team to clarify requirements, remove ambiguities, and ensure stories are ready for implementation. Work closely with the functional and automation testing teams to ensure all requirements are thoroughly tested and the delivered functionality works as expected. Review and accept completed stories, making timely decisions on scope, requirements, and priorities. Communicate product goals, roadmap updates, and delivery progress to stakeholders and project teams. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive successful execution and delivery of modernization objectives. aLeverage technology solutions and business knowledge to maximize product value and achieve project outcomes.

**Responsibilities**

* Review requirements and acceptance criteria; design and execute positive, negative, integration, and end-to-end test scenarios; maintain requirements-to-test traceability; log defects and validate fixes to confirm functionality works as expected.
* Identify suitable scenarios for automation; develop and maintain automated functional, API, and regression tests; execute automated suites and analyze failures; update scripts as requirements evolve and report coverage and results.
* Coordinate with the different workstreams Product Owner and development team to clarify requirements, prepare test data and environments, confirm coverage across functional and automated tests, and communicate test results, outstanding defects, and risks to support release-readiness decisions.
  

  

**Requirements**

* **Education:** B.E./ B. Tech/M.E./M. Tech/BSC/MSC/BCA/MCA (prefer IT/CS specialization)
* **Certifications If Any:** NA
* **Experience Range:** 12-16 yrs
  

  

**Mandatory skills:**

* US wire payment knowledge
* Experience in modernization from legacy platforms
* Strong payments knowledge.
* SWIFT and ISO20022 experience

  

**Desired skills**

* Good testing exposure and exposure in working with global teams

  

**Work Timings General Shift** - 11:30 AM to 8:30 PM

  
  

**Job Location** – Chennai

**Company Overview**
--------------------

Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. Milestone is focused on building an employee-first, performance-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. The company specializes in providing solutions across Application Services and Consulting, Digital Product Engineering, Digital Workplace Services, Private Cloud Services, AI/Automation, and ServiceNow. Milestone culture is built to provide a collaborative, inclusive environment that supports employees and empowers them to reach their full potential.  
  
Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone’s best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short-term and long-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.

  

**Job Overview**
----------------

Senior Product Manager, Data Platform

About the role

We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead our consumer data platform. We have a modern cloud lakehouse in place and are now building the consumer data foundation on top of it: a canonical data model, a consumer data warehouse, and one trusted source of data for analytics, data science, risk and finance teams.

You’ll own the roadmap from the start. You’ll decide which use cases to deliver first, define how core consumer entities are modeled, and make sure each new use case builds on shared data instead of one-off pipelines. You’ll work closely with data engineering, data architecture, analytics and risk teams.

*This is not a dashboard-building role. You’ll own the data, definitions and metrics that dashboards, models and reports are built on.*

What you’ll do in your first 12 months

* Build a prioritized backlog of consumer data use cases with analytics, data science, risk and finance, and decide which 3–5 to deliver first.
* Define canonical consumer entities, such as customer, account, transaction, fee, merchant, country and currency, so they mean the same thing across products.
* Decide where products share a common model and where they need their own structures, and document the reasoning.
* Define single, governed definitions for core consumer KPIs such as active customers, revenue per user, lifetime value and churn.
* Write requirements engineers can build from: source-to-target mappings, grain, keys, history rules and data-quality checks.
* Track adoption: which teams have moved to the new models, how much they’re being used, and how many metric discrepancies have been resolved.

Required qualifications

* **Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or an MBA, or equivalent practical experience.**
* **6+ years of product management experience**, including **2+ years in a data product or risk data role**.
* Experience starting with many competing data requests, choosing the few to build first, defining an MVP, and explaining the trade-offs to stakeholders.
* Experience working with engineering to deliver a **data lake/lakehouse, data warehouse or shared data model** used by multiple teams.
* Experience bringing together **inconsistent data from multiple source systems** into common entities, keys and definitions.
* **Hands-on SQL**: you can join across tables, profile data for nulls and duplicates, reconcile counts between systems, and check whether data supports a use case without waiting for an analyst.

Preferred qualifications

* Experience with **consumer payments, digital wallets or fintech**.
* Experience with **payments risk data** such as fraud, account takeover, KYC/AML or transaction monitoring signals.
* Experience with **modern cloud data platforms and tools**, such as Snowflake, Databricks, dbt or major cloud providers’ data services.

**Compensation**
----------------

Estimated Pay Range:  
  
Exact compensation and offers of employment are dependent on circumstances of each case and will be determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, licenses or certifications, and location.

  

**Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion**
-------------------------------------------

*At Milestone we strive to create a workplace that reflects the communities we serve and work with, where we all feel empowered to bring our full, authentic selves to work. We know creating a diverse and inclusive culture that champions equity and belonging is not only the right thing to do for our employees but is also critical to our continued success.*  
  
*Milestone Technologies provides equal employment opportunity for all applicants and employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, marital status, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, national origin, or any other category protected by applicable federal and state law, or local ordinance. Milestone also makes reasonable accommodations for disabled applicants and employees.*  
  
*We welcome the unique background, culture, experiences, knowledge, innovation, self-expression and perspectives you can bring to our global community. Our recruitment team is looking forward to meeting you.*

job_description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

**Senior Product Manager, Shipping as a Service** (L25)

  
  

**About the Team and the Role**

  
  

**eBay Shipping is evolving from a marketplace capability into a reusable global platform.** Our ambition is to make eBay's shipping services available to eBay entities and subsidiaries, external marketplaces, third-party commerce and logistics platforms, and sellers operating across multiple channels.

We are looking for a customer-obsessed Senior Product Manager to own the end-to-end partner and client journey - from opportunity discovery and solution shaping through integration, launch and adoption. You will help early clients succeed while ensuring their needs are translated into scalable platform patterns rather than one-off implementations.

This role sits at the intersection of B2B product, developer experience and global go-to-market. You will work closely with eBay Shipping Product and Engineering teams, Design, Analytics, Business, Legal, Finance, Operations and partner-management teams to create a repeatable model for bringing new clients onto the platform.

  
  

**What you will Accomplish**

* Define the product strategy and roadmap for client onboarding, partner integrations and adoption of Shipping as a Service.

* Segment and prioritize target customers and use cases across eBay entities, subsidiaries, marketplaces, third-party platforms, high-volume sellers and multi-channel businesses.

* Own the complete client journey from discovery and requirements through technical integration, certification, production launch, growth and support.

* Develop repeatable integration patterns, reference journeys and onboarding playbooks that reduce time to first API call, first label and production scale.

* Partner with the Platform PM and Engineering teams to translate client needs into reusable APIs, configuration and operational capabilities.

* Shape the developer and partner experience, including documentation, onboarding, authentication and access controls, sandbox journeys, sample applications, integration checklists, and support processes.

* Work with client teams to define embedded shipping experiences that are simple, trustworthy and consistent while allowing appropriate flexibility for their customers.

* Lead cross-functional launch readiness across Product, Engineering, Business, Legal, Security, Payments, Reconciliation, Shipping Operations, Customer Support and Analytics.

* Build feedback loops with clients and partners to identify friction, prioritize improvements and continuously strengthen the platform proposition.

* Establish and own adoption metrics such as integration cycle time, activation, active clients, shipment volume, repeat usage, support contacts and partner satisfaction.

* Tell a compelling product and business story that aligns senior stakeholders around target clients, investment priorities, launch sequencing and measurable outcomes.

  
  

**What you will Bring**

* 5+ years of product management experience, ideally across B2B, B2B2C, marketplaces, SaaS, developer products or platform integrations.

* Experience taking complex integrations from early discovery through production launch and adoption.

* Strong customer-discovery skills and the ability to distinguish reusable platform needs from client-specific requests.

* A track record of designing effective onboarding, activation or partner experiences using qualitative insight and funnel data.

* Strong understanding of APIs and technical integrations, with the ability to work credibly with client and platform engineering teams.

* Excellent product judgement, prioritization and execution discipline in ambiguous, multi-stakeholder environments.

* Strong analytical mindset; comfortable defining metrics, measuring integration and adoption funnels, and using data to prioritize improvements.

* Exceptional communication and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to align senior internal leaders and external partners.

* Ability to operate globally across markets, time zones, regulatory models and different client operating contexts.

**Additional Details**

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

  

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center, and AI Hiring Guidelines.

Apply Now

* Translate user needs and business objectives into clear product specifications, user stories, workflows, and acceptance criteria.
* Partner with engineering, design, and business stakeholders to deliver features and improvements.
* Own prioritization decisions, manage competing requirements, and balance customer needs with technical constraints.
* Work through integrations, APIs, system workflows, and implementation trade-offs with technical teams.
* Use product analytics, customer feedback, and research to identify opportunities and measure outcomes.
* Maintain clear ownership, timelines, and alignment across multiple initiatives.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* 4–7 years of hands-on Product Management experience in SaaS, enterprise software, or technology-driven products.
* Experience owning features or product initiatives from discovery through delivery.
* Ability to write structured product requirements and communicate effectively with engineering teams.
* Strong analytical thinking and a data-informed approach to decision-making.
* Confidence in stakeholder management, prioritization, and working through ambiguity.
* A proactive mindset, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.

If you enjoy owning product problems end-to-end and turning complex requirements into well-executed solutions, we’d love to hear from you.

Hyperproof is on a mission to transform the Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) world with a powerful new software platform. With Hyperproof, companies can save time and money while also operating their programs at a much higher level of effectiveness and accountability. We envision a world where organizations we depend on are truly trustworthy - and Hyperproof is the platform that will get them there.

We have a great team and culture - picture yourself in a highly collaborative startup environment where you can make a real impact on something truly important. It's an exciting time to be at Hyperproof; we raised our Series B round in 2023, validating our teamwork and company vision, and we continue to grow rapidly.

We are seeking a visionary and hands-on Senior Platform Product Manager to serve as a product leader and GRC domain strategy owner across our platform. In this high-impact individual contributor role, you will define and execute our holistic AI product strategy, driving the next generation of agentic systems, trustworthy automation, and eval-driven GRC workflows. You will focus on high-impact problem selection, grounding, and auditability to ensure our intelligent features deliver provable value and measurable time-bound outcomes within rigorous compliance guardrails.

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**

* **AI Product Vision & Strategy:** Own the end-to-end strategy, architecture, roadmap, and execution for Hyperproof's platform AI capabilities, intelligent agents, and automated workflows covering the full spectrum of the platform capabilities.
* **Eval-Driven & Strategic Product Leadership:** Partner directly with engineering and GRC subject matter experts to author detailed product requirements, establish trust and grounding frameworks, define rigorous eval-driven development benchmarks, and maintain strict auditability and AI safety guardrails.
* **Agentic Workflows & Automation:** Lead the innovation of customer-facing AI agents and backend service integrations that automate complex, everyday GRC tasks for enterprise customers.
* **Cross-Functional Architecture Alignment:** Collaborate with executive stakeholders, engineering, design, and GRC domain experts to define constraint spaces, evaluation frameworks, and model integration standards across the platform. Ensure continuous partnership and alignment with go-to-market teams and establish strong customer relationships that drive product innovation aligned with the most important customer use cases.
* **Data-Driven & Experimental Validation:** Build rapid functional prototypes, analyze product usage metrics, establish rigorous eval benchmarks, and leverage customer feedback to continuously validate and improve AI features in production.
* **Thought Leadership & Market Advisory:** Serve as Hyperproof's subject matter expert on AI in governance, risk, and compliance at industry events, executive briefings, and customer advisory sessions.

**HOW YOU'LL KNOW YOU ARE SUCCESSFUL**

* Hundreds of enterprise companies, including well-known Fortune 500 customers, rely daily on your AI agents and workflows to automate compliance with provable, verifiable outcomes.
* Customers post rave reviews highlighting the speed, accuracy, and reliability of Hyperproof's AI features.
* You set the technical and strategic bar for AI product development across the company, elevating the capabilities of cross-functional team members.
* You successfully translate emerging AI/LLM technology advancements into defensible, high-value product opportunities that differentiate Hyperproof in the market.
* You drive measurable, time-bound business outcomes that increase platform efficiency and reduce manual compliance effort for enterprise customer teams.

* 8+ years of product management experience scaling enterprise SaaS platforms, with 2+ years of direct experience shipping production-grade AI/LLM products, agentic systems.

* 3rd Interview
* 4th Interview

* Annual compensation reviews + equity
* Unlimited PTO: strongly encouraged to unplug and recharge
* Health: coverage for medical, dental, and vision - employee and dependents
* 401K, which vests immediately, complete with a 4% company match
* 12 weeks of Parental leave and 1 year free diapers and wipes with Honest
* Annual company in-person events and quarterly in-person connects
* $500 home office stipend - at the time of hire. Any additional home office needs are requested as needed.
* $100 quarterly paid wellness stipend
* Pet insurance discount
* Slack channel notifications turn off after 5 pm based on your time zone
* Two Hypercharge weeks of rest where we close company-wide (July & Dec)

It's an exciting time to be at Hyperproof — we recently raised $40 million in our Series B financing, further cementing Hyperproof as the emerging leader in the risk and compliance management space.

At Hyperproof's core are our passionate team members who focus on user experience, beautiful design, and evangelize a positive social impact of our cloud based platform. We help organizations streamline their risk and compliance workflows so our customers can spend more time strategically managing programs and less time wrangling spreadsheets.

We are disrupting the governance, risk, and compliance software space with our innovative platform by helping traditionally unsung heroes (compliance professionals) **do the right things so the wrong things don't happen.**

Learn more about the @hyperproof culture and how it all started.

**A NOTE ABOUT OUR INTERVIEW PROCESS**

We're committed to creating a fair, respectful, and secure hiring experience for everyone. As part of that commitment, we use standard verification steps throughout our interview process.

Here's what that means for you:

* We may conduct routine verification checks during the hiring process.
* You might be asked additional questions to better understand your experience and background.
* For video interviews, we ask that candidates be on camera without filters or visual modifications.

These steps are applied consistently for all candidates and are designed to ensure an equitable experience for everyone.

**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER**

Hyperproof is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace — it's one of our core values! Hyperproof is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

Our company is dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role, but your experience doesn't perfectly fit every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this role or others.

To ensure a smooth interview process, all candidates will be required to provide a valid phone number that is *not* a VOIP (Voice Over Internet Protocol) number. This helps us maintain clear and reliable communication throughout your interview experience.

title: Senior Product Manager - AI
job_description:
**Vacancy Name**

Senior Product Manager - AI

  

**Vacancy No**

VN1077

  

**Job Title**

Senior Product Manager - AI

  

**Work Location City**

Bangalore

  

**About Solifi**

Solifi deliver a solid financial technology foundation for equipment, working capital, wholesale, and automotive finance firms. At Solifi, we believe that commerce is only as strong as the system it runs on. Our mission is to reshape finance technology by bringing together proven solutions into a singular powerful technology platform designed to help protect and scale financial organizations. We guard our customers by being precise and reliable, we guide their success by combining powerful technology with proven expertise, and we help them grow by unleashing their potential.

  

**About the Team**

We are a small, high ownership AI team operating with the pace and ownership of a startup within a global enterprise. We build production grade AI products that are used by real customers, taking ideas from early experimentation and prototyping through evaluation, production deployment and continuous improvement. The team brings together AI product management, AI engineering and data expertise, with a strong emphasis on shipping, experimentation, quality and measurable customer outcomes. We work closely with product, engineering and domain teams across the business to identify where AI can create meaningful value and then build the systems required to deliver it reliably at scale. This is an opportunity to work on some of the core AI products shaping how modern AI is applied within enterprise software, while having significant influence over what we build, how we evaluate it and how AI products are built and operated in production.

  

**About the Position**

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager - AI to lead the development of production grade AI products that solve complex problems for enterprise customers.
  
  
This is a highly hands on product role for someone who understands that building AI products is fundamentally different from building traditional software. You will work at the intersection of product, data, AI, and domain expertise, with significant ownership over both the product outcome and the process used to prove that the AI system can reliably deliver it.
  
  
This is a builder role. You will not simply manage a backlog of AI features or translate requirements between customers and engineering. You will be expected to understand the problem, formulate the hypothesis, work with the data, determine how AI can solve it, establish how success will be measured, validate the solution and drive it all the way into production.
  
  
The goal is not to build AI for the sake of using AI. The goal is to build reliable, production-grade AI products that create measurable value for enterprise customers.

  

**Role and Responsibilities**

Identify high value customer problems, develop hypotheses around where AI can create measurable value and validate those hypotheses using data, experimentation and customer feedback.
  
  
Work hands on with large and complex datasets to understand the problem, identify patterns, test assumptions, and determine what is required to build an effective AI solution.
  
  
Partner with AI engineering and data teams to design AI powered product experiences, including grounding and retrieval systems, prompts, model selection, orchestration and AI workflows.
  
  
Build and own AI evaluation frameworks, including evaluation datasets, golden sets, test cases, metrics, automated evaluations, and human evaluation processes.
  
  
Establish AI monitoring and observability for production systems and use evaluation and production data to identify failures, understand root causes and continuously improve the product.
  
  
Drive AI capabilities from prototype and proof of concept through production deployment, customer adoption and continuous improvement.
  
  
Define and measure the product and AI metrics that demonstrate whether the system is delivering the intended customer outcome.

  

**About You**

What We Are Looking For: • 7+ years of product management experience, with significant experience building and shipping B2B software products. • Strong hands-on experience building AI-powered products, where AI is a core part of the product experience and customer outcome. • Deep practical understanding of AI evaluation and experience building evaluation frameworks for AI products. • Strong experience with AI monitoring and observability, including identifying, diagnosing, and addressing failures in production AI systems. • Strong data skills and experience working with large-scale data. You should be comfortable understanding data structures, exploring datasets, analyzing data, and using data to validate product hypotheses and AI behavior. • Experience designing and building grounding systems and evaluation systems, rather than simply consuming AI APIs. • Experience with modern AI application architectures, including LLMs, RAG, embeddings, prompting, model selection, agents/workflows, and orchestration. • Demonstrated ability to take an ambiguous problem, formulate hypotheses, validate them with data and experimentation, and turn the resulting insight into a production product. • Experience building products for B2B customers in heavily regulated industries, such as financial services, fintech, insurance, healthcare, or similar domains. • Strong understanding of enterprise AI considerations including accuracy, reliability, explainability, security, governance, data quality, and auditability. • Ability to work deeply with technical teams and engage in detailed discussions about AI system behavior without needing to be the engineer implementing the system. • Familiarity with the AWS ecosystem is preferred. • Strong product judgment and the ability to distinguish between an impressive AI demo and an AI system that is genuinely reliable enough for production use. What Will Set You Apart: • You have taken an AI product from hypothesis prototype evaluation production continuous monitoring and improvement. • You have personally designed or owned an AI evaluation framework and understand why evaluation is central to building reliable AI products. • You have worked through difficult AI failure modes and know how to investigate whether a problem originates in the model, data, retrieval, grounding, prompting, orchestration, or product workflow. • You have experience building AI products where incorrect outputs have meaningful business or customer consequences. • You are comfortable challenging an initial hypothesis when the data or evaluations do not support it. • You naturally think in terms of measurable customer outcomes rather than AI features. • You enjoy getting into the details and are equally comfortable discussing a customer workflow, analyzing an evaluation dataset, investigating AI output failures, and working with engineers on the product architecture.

  

**Preferred Experience Level**

7 years

  

**Preferred Education Level**

Master's Degree

  

**Employment Basis**

Full Time

  

**Benefits**

Group Medical Insurance, Group Personal Accident, Employee Anniversary gift, Loyalty Bonus, Employee Referral Bonus, Rewards and Recognition program, Wellness Allowance, Privilege Leave (PL): 15 days per year, Casual Leave (CL) 12 days per year, Maternity/paternity/Bereavement leave

  

**Applications Close Date**

07 Apr 2027
