title: Senior Product Manager- SCM/Ecommerce
job_description:
As a Product Manager at Oracle NetSuite, you will help shape and deliver supply chain, Mobile, and Warehouse Management solutions from discovery through release. You will work closely with engineering, design, quality assurance, support, and go-to-market teams to solve customer problems and deliver products on schedule and within budget.

You will define product strategy, requirements, and priorities using customer feedback, business needs, and product insights. A key part of the role is identifying where GenAI and intelligent automation can simplify workflows, reduce manual effort, and improve the user experience. You will translate these opportunities into clear requirements and measurable outcomes, considering accuracy, data privacy, and user control.

Your responsibilities will include aligning teams on product decisions, reviewing designs and documentation, managing dependencies, and supporting successful releases. You will also use AI tools to improve product discovery, requirements development, documentation, and test planning, while applying sound judgment to their outputs.

This role requires independent judgment, strong communication, and the ability to manage complex priorities. You may lead cross-functional initiatives and mentor junior colleagues. A bachelor’s or master’s degree in a relevant field, or equivalent practical experience, is required.

  

Responsbilities:

* Collaborate with Manufacturers and Wholesale Distributors to build the next generation of supply chain solution
* Proactively define and drive the creation of new features that customers love
* Identify opportunities to use GenAI and intelligent automation to simplify workflows, improve decisions, and reduce manual effort
* Create use cases, user stories, and detailed product requirements document that clearly articulate desired product functionality
* Collaborate with Development, QA, Doc, and UI to deliver great products and tools for both the customers as well as developers
* Build a strong understanding of the market, competitive landscape, and emerging AI capabilities relevant to supply chain operations
* Manage the product backlog and prioritize product enhancements, customer and partner requests by making smart, decisive tradeoffs using data-driven analysis and sound judgment
* Partner with Marketing, Sales, Professional Services and Support to successfully rollout our products and ensure a great end-to-end customer experience
Evaluate AI-enabled features for usefulness, accuracy, reliability, and appropriate user control  

Qualifications/Skills:

* Must be a self-motivated team player
* Ability to gather complex customer requirements and translate requirements into a detail plan for execution
* Strong functional knowledge in at least two areas: Inventory, Warehouse Management, Fulfillment, Shipping, or Outbound Order Processing
* Preferably 5+ years of product management experience, with experience delivering applications through at least two product releases
* Practical experience with GenAI or AI-related projects is a plus, particularly in enterprise applications, workflow automation, or decision support
* Ability to identify meaningful AI use cases and define how their value and quality will be measured.
B.Tech or Bachelor of Engineering required. MBA a plus  

Oracle NetSuite is investing in GenAI and AI-powered capabilities to improve supply chain execution, decision-making, and productivity. In this role, you will help shape intelligent workflows, predictive insights, automated configuration, and GenAI-enabled experiences across Mobile and WMS, making everyday work simpler and more effective for customers.

* Collaborate with Manufacturers and Wholesale Distributors to build the next generation of supply chain solution
* Proactively define and drive the creation of new features that customers love
* Identify opportunities to use GenAI and intelligent automation to simplify workflows, improve decisions, and reduce manual effort
* Create use cases, user stories, and detailed product requirements document that clearly articulate desired product functionality
* Collaborate with Development, QA, Doc, and UI to deliver great products and tools for both the customers as well as developers
* Build a strong understanding of the market, competitive landscape, and emerging AI capabilities relevant to supply chain operations
* Manage the product backlog and prioritize product enhancements, customer and partner requests by making smart, decisive tradeoffs using data-driven analysis and sound judgment
* Partner with Marketing, Sales, Professional Services and Support to successfully rollout our products and ensure a great end-to-end customer experience
Evaluate AI-enabled features for usefulness, accuracy, reliability, and appropriate user control  

Qualifications/Skills:

* Must be a self-motivated team player
* Ability to gather complex customer requirements and translate requirements into a detail plan for execution
* Strong functional knowledge in at least two areas: Inventory, Warehouse Management, Fulfillment, Shipping, or Outbound Order Processing
* Preferably 5+ years of product management experience, with experience delivering applications through at least two product releases
* Practical experience with GenAI or AI-related projects is a plus, particularly in enterprise applications, workflow automation, or decision support
* Ability to identify meaningful AI use cases and define how their value and quality will be measured.
B.Tech or Bachelor of Engineering required. MBA a plus  

Oracle NetSuite is investing in GenAI and AI-powered capabilities to improve supply chain execution, decision-making, and productivity. In this role, you will help shape intelligent workflows, predictive insights, automated configuration, and GenAI-enabled experiences across Mobile and WMS, making everyday work simpler and more effective for customers.

### **Senior Product Manager - Oracle RMCS**

* JR-164209
* Hybrid

* Bengaluru

* Technology Enablement

* Full time

**Who are we?**

Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.

A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.

A career at Equinix means being at the center of shaping what comes next and amplifying customer value through innovation and impact. You’ll work across teams, influence key decisions, and help shape the path forward. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a Senior Oracle Cloud Revenue Management (RMCS) Techno-Functional Product Manager with expertise in Oracle RMCS, Subscription Management, Oracle Cloud Finance modules and AI-driven automation solutions. The ideal candidate will partner with business and IT stakeholders to design, implement, enhance, and support revenue management applications while leveraging automation and AI capabilities to improve operational efficiency, business processes, and user experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead Oracle RMCS implementation, enhancement, and support initiatives.
* Gather business requirements, perform fit-gap analysis, and design scalable solutions.
* Configure and support Oracle RMCS, Subscription Management, SLA, AR, and GL modules.
* Ensure compliance with ASC 606/IFRS 15 revenue recognition standards.
* Design and support integrations with Oracle Cloud applications and external systems.
* Identify opportunities to leverageAI, automation, and analyticsto improve revenue operations, reporting, and support processes.
* Partner with business and technical teams to implement intelligent workflows, process automation, and AI-enabled solutions.
* Defines test strategy and execution approach to test specific functionality
* Design release scope and schedules aligned with business needs
* Develop test scripts and execute comprehensive test plans and procedures
* Coordinate integration testing, validate test cases with stakeholders for user acceptance testing and training, and secure necessary approvals
* Brings in best practices by keeping up-to-date with technology and vendor products
* Manage defect clarification, triage, and coordinate resolution with engineering teams
* Troubleshoot functional, technical, and integration issues and drive resolution.
* Create and maintain solution documentation, business process flows, and test scenarios.
* Collaborate with global teams and mentor junior team members.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Business, Finance, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 7+ years of Oracle ERP experience with at least 3 years focused on Oracle RMCS.
* Hands-on experience with Oracle RMCS, Subscription Management, AR, SLA and GL.
* Strong understanding of ASC 606/IFRS 15 revenue recognition principles.
* Experience with FBDI, data conversions and Oracle PL/SQL.
* Experience implementing or supporting AI-driven automation, workflow optimization, analytics, or digital transformation initiatives.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* Oracle Cloud Financials and/or RMCS Certifications
* Experience with Oracle FDI, Tableau, Salesforce OM, and reporting solutions.
* Experience with AI/ML-based business process automation tools and Oracle AI capabilities.
* Agile/Scrum delivery experience.
* Knowledge of SaaS and subscription-based business models.

Equinix is committed to ensuring that our employment process is open to all individuals, including those with a disability. If you are a qualified candidate and need assistance or an accommodation, please let us know by completing form.

Equinix is an Equal Employment Opportunity and, in the U.S., an Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to unlawful consideration of race, color, religion, creed, national or ethnic origin, ancestry, place of birth, citizenship, sex, pregnancy / childbirth or related medical conditions, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital or domestic partnership status, age, veteran or military status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, political / organizational affiliation, status as a victim or family member of a victim of crime or abuse, or any other status protected by applicable law.

**We use artificial intelligence in our hiring process. Learn more** **here****.**

This posting is for a backfill position, meaning it is to fill an existing vacancy within our organization.

title: Senior Principal - SN Finance, Risk & Legal Product Owner
job_description:
Business Introduction  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose**

The Product Owner owns the backlog and roadmap for a DPTF platform product, translating what GSK teams need into prioritised work and maximising the value the platform delivers to the teams that consume it. The role works daily with engineering to deliver increments and accept completed work, links every backlog item to strategy and OKRs, and measures adoption and outcome rather than output. Products span cloud, network, digital workplace and AI Hub domains, and the specific product is set on appointment.

The role sits inside the platform team and holds genuine product decision rights over backlog order and acceptance. Platform strategy and the multi-year roadmap sit with the Platform Manager, domain demand and sequencing sit with the Domain Portfolio Manager, technical design and standards sit with the Platform Architect, and the reliability bar sits with Reliability Engineering. This is an insourced role under the DPTF sourcing decisions, so it is not delivered through a managed service partner.

The Product Owner leads a group of related Products, CSM for Finance and Procurement, Legal Service Delivery within the ServiceNow Platform & Enterprise Tools Domain, ensuring they deliver measurable value, support business processes, and are continuously improved.

**Key Responsibilities**

Describe the key deliverables to be achieved by the post holder and the ongoing responsibilities of the role

* Partner with business stakeholders to understand functional needs, refine requirements, and define product outcomes that support business priorities, within guardrails set by the ServiceNow Business, Risk & Security Product Manager and the Senior Director of ServiceNow Platform & Enterprise Tools.
* Own and prioritise the product backlog by value, risk and reliability, applying lean portfolio principles rather than fixed project plans.
* Link every backlog item explicitly to GSK D&T strategy and domain OKRs, and measure the outcome with a named metric.
* Translate consumer needs and business outcomes into clear requirements and user stories that engineering can act on without further interpretation.
* Work daily with the engineering team through refinement, planning and review, and accept completed increments against agreed criteria.
* Balance new capability against the reliability bar, agreeing SLOs and error budget impact with Reliability Engineering before committing to work.
* Use AI tooling to accelerate discovery, backlog refinement and requirement drafting, and record where AI-assisted output has been reviewed before acceptance.
* Measure product adoption, self-service uptake and value delivered, and iterate the roadmap on that evidence rather than on stakeholder volume.
* Steer delivery with flow metrics such as throughput, cycle time and work in progress, and act on them rather than reporting them.
* Manage consumer demand and stakeholder expectations, saying no with a reason where an item does not compete on value.
* Manage supplier-delivered components within the product, holding partners to the same acceptance criteria and reliability standards as internal work.
* Contribute the product view into the domain roadmap held by the Platform Manager and the portfolio view held by the Domain Portfolio Manager.
* Hold the boundaries with the Platform Manager on platform strategy, the Platform Architect on technical design and standards, and Reliability Engineering on the reliability bar.

**Professional Qualifications**

* Degree in a technology, engineering or business discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e.g., Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering).
* Agile or product certifications desirable (e.g., Certified Scrum Product Owner, SAFe Product Owner / Product Manager).

**Area of Specialisation**

* Product ownership in a platform or agile environment, covering backlog management, prioritisation and increment acceptance.
* Outcome measurement, covering OKRs, adoption metrics and flow metrics used to steer delivery.

**Minimum Level of Job-Related Experience Required**

* Overall 15 years and typically 5 or more years in product ownership or product management, including at least two years owning a backlog in a platform or infrastructure context with experience.
* Practical experience of lean or agile backlog management, including prioritisation by value and risk rather than by request order.
* Track record of translating business needs into requirements that engineering teams could deliver without repeated clarification.
* Experience working to OKRs and measuring adoption or value delivered rather than features shipped.
* Experience steering with flow metrics and acting on delivery predictability data.
* Experience managing stakeholders and declining requests with a defensible reason.
* Exposure to AI tooling used for discovery, backlog refinement or requirement drafting.

**Skills/Background**

* Decisiveness on backlog order, including the confidence to sequence against value rather than seniority of the requester.
* Clear written communication, since requirements and acceptance criteria are the role's primary output.
* Enough technical literacy to challenge engineering estimates and understand reliability trade-offs.
* Comfort with data as the basis for roadmap change rather than stakeholder pressure.
* Collaborative habit with architecture and reliability colleagues who can veto on standards grounds.

**Skills**

Agile Delivery, Agile Methodology, Cross-Functional Teamwork, Data Analysis, Design Thinking, DevOps, Executive Communications, Leadership Strategies, Prioritization, Product Development Research, Product Roadmapping, Project Management, Return on Investment (ROI), ServiceNow Customer Service Management (CSM), ServiceNow Human Resource Service Delivery (HRSD), Software Development, Stakeholder Management, Strategy Deployment, User Experience (UX), User Interface (UI) Design

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Inclusion at GSK:**

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

It has come to our attention that the names of GlaxoSmithKline or GSK or our group companies are being used in connection with bogus job advertisements or through unsolicited emails asking candidates to make some payments for recruitment opportunities and interview. Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.

**GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.**

If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk.com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in “gsk.com”, you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk.com, so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

### **ABOUT XACTLY**

### **Xactly is the global leader in AI-driven Sales Performance Orchestration. We help enterprise organizations align revenue strategy with execution — connecting planning, incentives, and performance in one Intelligent Revenue Platform. Trusted by industry leading companies worldwide, Xactly empowers sales teams to perform at their peak.**

### **THE OPPORTUNITY –**

### **Senior Product Manager In this role, you will be part of a lively, high-performing Product Management team that shapes the future of Xactly’s AI-powered application ecosystem. You will collaborate closely with User Experience professionals, engineering teams, and clients to discover innovative solutions, solve complex challenges, and contribute to delivering high-impact product outcomes for customers and stakeholders.**

### **WHAT YOU’LL DO**

* **Lead concurrent product initiatives and agile scrum rituals by defining requirements, grooming the product backlog, and translating user needs into actionable units of work for the development team.**
* **Partner directly with external clients, Customer Success, and Implementation teams to conduct user research, validate product concepts, and drive continuous product innovation.**
* **Define and track key product performance metrics, performing deep-dive quantitative analyses to identify areas for improvement and present strategic recommendations to stakeholders.**
* **Manage the end-to-end product lifecycle for assigned functional areas, including triaging bugs, prioritizing feature requests, and refining test plans in collaboration with Engineering.**

### **WHAT YOU’LL BRING**

### **Must-Have Skills**

### **8+ years of product management experience in the enterprise SaaS industry, supported by a foundational understanding of software development and web-based technologies. Hands-on experience managing Product Functions, App Ecosystems, and AI initiatives, alongside intermediate proficiency in SQL. Proven track record of working directly with external clients and cross-functional internal teams to gather requirements and drive product strategy. Strong analytical, quantitative, and problem-solving skills with the ability to communicate complex concepts clearly to both technical and business stakeholders.**

### **Good-to-Have Skills**

* **Prior experience building or managing incentive compensation management (ICM) applications.**
* **Previous hands-on engineering experience or a related technical degree.**

### **WHY XACTLY BENEFITS AND PERKS**

* **Competitive base salary + performance-based incentive**
* **Comprehensive insurance coverage**
* **Flexible time off and sick days**
* **Short-term disability, long-term disability, maternity and parental leave**
* **Gym/fitness reimbursement and tuition reimbursement**
* **Flexible savings account & Health savings account**
* **Paid holidays and up to 3 days paid community and volunteer leave**
* **Life and AD&D insurance.**
* **401(k) Retirement Savings Plan**
* **Access to wellness programs**
* **Employee discount program**
* **Additional voluntary benefits such as pet insurance, critical illness, accident insurance, hospital indemnity, and legal plan**

### **OUR VISION:** **To power the revenue engine of the companies changing the world.**

### **OUR CORE VALUES:**

### **Customer Focus | Accountability | Respect | Excellence (CARE) are the keys to our success, and each day we’re committed to upholding them by delivering the best we can to our customers.**

### **Xactly is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. Xactly provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by law. This means we believe in celebrating diversity and creating an inclusive workplace environment, where everyone feels valued, heard, and has a sense of belonging. By doing this, everyone in the Xactly family has the power to make a d****ifference and unleash their full potential.**

### **We do not accept resumes from agencies, headhunters, or other suppliers who have not signed a formal agreement with us.**

title: Sr. Product Manager I - Data Mesh
job_description:
For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it's what we show up for every day.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own DataMesh, one of Smartsheet's most widely used cross-sheet data capabilities and a critical part of how enterprise customers build and run their solutions today. DataMesh sits at the centre of a multi-year shift in Smartsheet's data model, as we evolve towards column links and, ultimately, relational data capabilities.

**You Will:**

* Own the product strategy and roadmap for DataMesh, balancing near-term stability and customer needs against the longer-term migration strategy
* Own the operational stability and serviceability of DataMesh, partnering with engineering and Support to prioritise defects, performance issues, and escalations
* Shape and execute the migration path from DataMesh to column links, working closely with the Data Links PM on feature parity, the advanced column links roadmap, and report-as-a-source as a critical dependency
* Lead customer and user discovery with enterprise personas (work admins, solution builders, system administrators, and power users) to understand how DataMesh is used in practice, identify migration blockers, and validate decisions before they ship
* Partner with Customer Success and GTM to plan communications, enablement, and migration support for enterprise accounts that depend on DataMesh
* Work with one or more engineering squads, navigating dependencies and making clear scoping and sequencing decisions across a complex, interconnected backlog
* Author clear product briefs, requirements docs, and feature specs that design and engineering can execute on without ambiguity
* Define success metrics for everything you ship, including DataMesh usage, migration progress, and quality indicators, and partner with data and analytics teams on instrumentation and reporting
* Represent DataMesh in leadership reviews, WBRs, and customer conversations, including enterprise account engagements
* Perform other duties as assigned

**You Have:**

* 4+ years of product management experience delivering features within enterprise SaaS or B2B software products
* Experience with data management, data modelling, workflow automation, platform integrations, or cross-sheet data referencing is a strong plus
* Experience managing a mature product through sustain, deprecation, or migration phases is a plus
* Strong customer instincts: you can run structured discovery, synthesise customer feedback, and turn it into well-scoped, validated product decisions
* A track record of writing product briefs, requirements docs, and specs that engineering and design can act on without ambiguity
* Demonstrated ability to drive cross-functional alignment across engineering, design, GTM, and Customer Success
* Comfort working with engineering teams across time zones, including stakeholders in North America
* A data-driven mindset: you define adoption and quality metrics before you ship and use post-launch data to guide iteration
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including confidence presenting in leadership reviews and speaking directly with enterprise customers
* Familiarity with API-driven product development or working alongside platform engineering teams is a plus
* Legally eligible to work in India on an ongoing basis
* Fluency in English is required

**Get to Know Us:**

At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You'll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths—because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. When you're doing work that stretches you, excites you, and connects you to something bigger, that's magic at work. Let's build what's next, together.

**Equal Opportunity Employer:**

Smartsheet is an Equal Opportunity (EEO) employer committed to fostering an inclusive environment with the best employees. It is our policy to provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants in accordance with applicable laws in the US, UK, Australia, Germany, Costa Rica, Japan, Bulgaria, India, and Singapore. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran or disabled status, or genetic information.

If there are preparations we can make to help ensure you have a comfortable and positive interview experience, please let us know.

Job ID

26WD101350

**Job Requisition ID #**

26WD101350

**Position Overview**

  
  

Autodesk is seeking a strategic and technically skilled Senior Product Manager to lead the modernization of our Marketing Technology (MarTech) ecosystem, with a primary focus on end-to-end Lead Management and pipeline progression.

In this role, you will define and execute product strategy across the lead lifecycle, from lead capture, enrichment, scoring, qualification, routing, and engagement through pipeline progression and conversion. You will collaborate closely with Attribution, Analytics, Data, and Go-to-Market (GTM) teams to ensure Lead Management capabilities are seamlessly connected across the broader MarTech ecosystem.

The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in Marketing Technology and Lead Management with strong product management skills and a passion for leveraging Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) to transform how leads are identified, qualified, prioritized, engaged, and converted.

You will partner with Marketing, Sales, Data Science, Engineering, Architecture, Operations, and Analytics teams to build intelligent, scalable solutions that improve lead quality, optimize seller productivity, accelerate pipeline progression, and drive revenue growth.

  
  

**Responsibilities**

  
  

* Define and execute the product strategy and roadmap for the MarTech portfolio, focusing on end-to-end Lead Management and pipeline progression while aligning technology investments with business objectives
* Lead the evolution of the Lead Management ecosystem, including lead capture, lifecycle management, enrichment, deduplication, scoring, qualification, routing, prioritization, engagement, and conversion
* Own the end-to-end lead-to-revenue experience, identifying opportunities to reduce friction and optimize conversion across every stage of the sales funnel
* Partner with Data Science and Engineering teams to develop and enhance Machine Learning (ML) and predictive models for lead scoring, qualification, prioritization, and conversion
* Drive AI-powered lead engagement and qualification through AI agents, AI-powered Sales Development Representative (AI-SDR) capabilities, and Copilot solutions that automate repetitive workflows, improve lead coverage, and provide sellers with timely, actionable insights
* Define strategies to improve lead quality and enrichment by leveraging first-party and external data sources to provide relevant context for qualification, scoring, routing, and seller engagement
* Establish measurable strategies and feedback loops to continuously improve lead scoring, qualification, routing, and conversion performance
* Partner with the Marketing Attribution Product Manager to define requirements and ensure attribution capabilities support end-to-end lead-to-pipeline measurement and decision-making
* Collaborate with GTM Product Managers to drive cross-functional initiatives and ensure Lead Management capabilities integrate seamlessly across Customer Relationship Management (CRM), marketing automation, Customer Data Platforms (CDPs), analytics, advertising, and other GTM systems
* Define product requirements, prioritize roadmaps, and collaborate with Engineering, User Experience (UX), Architecture, Technical Program Management, and Data teams to deliver high-impact solutions
* Leverage data, experimentation, and customer insights to identify opportunities, measure product success, and continuously improve lead-to-revenue outcomes
* Build strong relationships with Marketing, Sales, Sales Operations, Marketing Operations, Data Science, Finance, and executive stakeholders to align product investments with business priorities
* Champion AI innovation, experimentation, automation, and continuous improvement across the Lead Management ecosystem
  

  

**Minimum Qualifications**

  
  

* 10+ years of Product Management experience, including significant experience in Marketing Technology, Lead Management, or Go-to-Market (GTM) technology
* Deep expertise in end-to-end Lead Management, including lead lifecycle management, enrichment, scoring, qualification, routing, prioritization, engagement, and pipeline progression
* Strong understanding of modern GTM systems, including Customer Relationship Management (CRM), marketing automation, Customer Data Platforms (CDPs), Business Intelligence (BI) platforms, and sales engagement technologies
* Experience developing data-driven products and collaborating with Data Science or Machine Learning teams
* Strong understanding of lead scoring methodologies, predictive models, lead qualification, conversion optimization, and marketing measurement
* Proven ability to translate complex lead-to-revenue processes and business requirements into scalable product solutions
* Experience defining and measuring product Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), experimentation frameworks, and business outcomes
* Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with demonstrated experience influencing senior leadership across Marketing, Sales, and Technology organizations
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives involving Product, Engineering, Architecture, Data, User Experience, Operations, and Business teams
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

  
  

* Experience with Salesforce, Marketo, 6sense, Microsoft Power BI, Adobe Experience Platform, Customer Data Platforms, or similar Marketing Technology and GTM solutions
* Experience designing and launching AI-powered user experiences, AI agents, Copilot solutions, AI-powered Sales Development Representative capabilities, or Generative AI features for enterprise applications
* Experience developing or optimizing Machine Learning-based lead scoring, predictive lead qualification, or propensity models
* Experience with lead enrichment, identity resolution, data quality, and integration of external data providers into Lead Management workflows
* Familiarity with marketing attribution, experimentation, predictive analytics, and customer journey optimization
  

  

**The Ideal Candidate**

  
  

The ideal candidate is a strategic and technically accomplished Product Management professional who combines deep Marketing Technology expertise, analytical thinking, and cross-functional leadership to modernize Lead Management capabilities and deliver measurable business outcomes

  
  

* Demonstrates strong product leadership and a clear vision for modernizing and simplifying Lead Management through scalable, integrated technology solutions
* Applies deep knowledge of lead lifecycle management, marketing automation, and GTM systems to improve lead quality, qualification, and conversion
* Uses data, experimentation, and sound judgment to identify opportunities, prioritize initiatives, and drive measurable improvements in business performance
* Leverages Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to develop intelligent lead scoring, enrichment, qualification, prioritization, and routing capabilities
* Improves seller productivity by ensuring Sales teams receive qualified leads with relevant context at the appropriate time
* Drives AI-powered lead engagement and qualification to reduce manual effort, improve lead coverage, and accelerate response times
* Identifies and removes friction across the lead-to-pipeline journey to improve conversion rates and accelerate revenue opportunities
* Establishes closed-loop measurement and feedback mechanisms to continuously improve lead scoring, qualification, engagement, and conversion
* Builds trusted partnerships across Attribution, Analytics, Data Science, Marketing, Sales, Engineering, and GTM teams to deliver connected insights across the lead-to-revenue lifecycle
* Identifies opportunities to streamline operational processes through automation, AI-powered workflows, and scalable technology solutions
* Collaborates effectively across the GTM product portfolio to strengthen Marketing and Sales alignment and improve organizational productivity
* Influences strategic direction and serves as a trusted advisor to senior business and technology leaders
* Demonstrates strong ownership, adaptability, and a commitment to delivering measurable improvements in lead quality, pipeline progression, conversion, and revenue growth

Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.

  
  

We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world.

title: Product Manager – Life / Wealth Insurance
job_description:
We are seeking an experienced **Product Manager – Life / Wealth Insurance** with strong domain knowledge in life insurance or wealth insurance. The successful candidate will be responsible for product strategy, roadmap development, backlog prioritisation, stakeholder management, and end-to-end product delivery.

This role involves working closely with business stakeholders, Business Analysts, Product Owners, and technology teams to translate business requirements into effective product capabilities and deliver measurable business outcomes.

Candidates must currently be based in **Delhi NCR** and be willing to work on-site in Gurugram.

Key Responsibilities

* Own and prioritise the product backlog, including features, initiatives, and user stories.
* Define and maintain product roadmaps aligned with business goals and technology strategy.
* Gather business requirements and translate them into clear product specifications.
* Manage backlog refinement and prioritisation with Business Analysts, Product Owners, and technology teams.
* Work with Agile delivery teams to define scope, acceptance criteria, priorities, and expected outcomes.
* Coordinate stakeholders and resolve competing priorities, dependencies, and delivery challenges.
* Partner with technology teams across solution design, development, testing, implementation, and post-production support.
* Track product performance metrics, risks, milestones, and delivery progress.
* Identify opportunities for process improvement and enhance product performance.
* Communicate product updates, recommendations, and key decisions to senior stakeholders.

Required Skills and Qualifications

* 8–12 years of relevant professional experience.
* Strong hands-on domain knowledge in **Life Insurance or Wealth Insurance — mandatory**.
* Proven experience in Product Management, product delivery, or product backlog management.
* Experience defining product roadmaps, prioritising features, and managing user stories.
* Strong knowledge of Agile methodologies and cross-functional delivery.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to translate business needs into product requirements and measurable outcomes.
* B.E./B.Tech. degree required.
* Must be based in Delhi NCR and willing to work on-site in Gurugram.

Preferred Qualifications

* Previous MNC experience.
* CSPO, PSPO, SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager, or an equivalent product management certification.
* Experience working with high-net-worth (HNW) customer requirements.
* Experience managing complex products and coordinating multiple business and technology stakeholders.

Who Should Apply?

Product Managers or experienced product delivery professionals with substantial life insurance or wealth insurance experience, strong Agile delivery knowledge, and a track record of working with business and technology teams.

**Notice Period:** Immediate joiners are preferred. Candidates currently serving notice may also apply.

How to Apply

Apply through Indeed with your updated resume. You may also email your resume to **prabhjotgora@tasknera.com** with the subject line:

**TRX-26125 – Product Manager (Life / Wealth Insurance)**

Please mention your total experience, relevant insurance domain experience, current location, current CTC, expected CTC, and notice period.

Pay: Up to ₹2,500,000.00 per year

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Gurgaon H O, Haryana 122001

title: AGM- Product Manager
job_description:
**ABOUT US:**

BYLD Group is committed to making a difference to people and their organizations through its decades of excellence in business solutions, diverse corporate exposure, and skilled workforce. Our clients across various industries believe us in managing, developing, and aligning their corporate needs with their organizational goals and objectives.

Founded in the year 1998, BYLD is the largest group in the South Asian region, offering technology-enabled HR and business productivity solutions. We have served 5,00,000+ individuals, worked with more than 50% of the Fortune 500 and over 60% of the Business World top 1000 companies.

Please read about us – http://byldgroup.com

**Designation -** AGM / GM - Product Manager

**Experience -** 6-8 years

**Location -** Gurgaon, Haryana

**Job Description:**
--------------------

We are looking for an Assistant General Manager / General Manager – Product Management to own BYLD Group's staffing product. The business is operations-heavy, with many internal and client stakeholders. You will use AI and automation to improve how the end-to-end staffing process runs, ship new features, and drive their adoption.

This role carries end-to-end ownership of product outcomes. You will work directly with business stakeholders, engineering and operations, and are expected to design AI-enabled workflows and architecture, prototype them hands-on, and see them through to launch.

**Roles & Responsibilities:**
-----------------------------

* **Product ownership:** Own the roadmap, prioritization and delivery for the staffing platform, balancing business impact, effort and urgency as priorities change.
* **AI and workflow architecture:** Map the end-to-end staffing workflow, identify where AI and automation add the most value, and define how they are embedded into the platform architecture. Work with engineering on data flow, integrations, accuracy targets, fallbacks and human-in-the-loop checks.
* **Efficiency and automation:** Set measurable targets (turnaround time, recruiter productivity, cost per placement), decide what to build, buy or automate with no-code tools, and prototype quickly before committing engineering time.
* **New features and adoption:** Define and launch new features with operations users, track adoption, close the feedback loop, and retire what is not used.
* **Product opportunities:** Identify gaps across client-facing, candidate-facing and internal workflows and turn them into prioritized, evidence-backed proposals.
* **Stakeholder management:** Run a single intake and triage process for requests from operations, sales, delivery and leadership. Make trade-offs visible and communicate changes early.
* **Requirements and PRDs:** Extract clear requirements from non-technical users and write PRDs that engineering can build against.
* **Sprint execution:** Work with engineering to plan and run sprints, track scope, dependencies and timelines, and unblock issues as they arise.
* **Product operations:** Own the day-to-day operating rhythm of the product function: backlog hygiene, release coordination and checklists, sprint reporting, and regular status updates to stakeholders. Standardize PRD, sprint and release templates so execution stays consistent as the team scales.
* **Metrics and reporting:** Track operational efficiency and product metrics (sprint velocity, release health, feature adoption), analyse NPS, support tickets and feature requests, and report outcomes to leadership.
* **Design collaboration:** Brief the in-house designer, review output against the original ask, and use AI design tools for mock-ups when design support is unavailable.
* **Tooling and onboarding:** Own and maintain the product tooling stack (project management, design, analytics, feedback), keep its data clean, document processes

**Requirements:**
-----------------

* 6–8 years in Product Management or Product Operations, ideally in staffing, recruitment tech, HR-tech or other operations-heavy B2B platforms.
* Hands-on product operations experience: backlog management, release coordination, sprint reporting, stakeholder status updates, and building templates and processes that scale.
* Proven ability to improve operational efficiency with AI and automation, with measurable results (hours saved, turnaround time reduced).
* Clear understanding of how to embed AI into a product architecture: where LLMs, OCR and document intelligence, and rules-based automation each fit, how to measure accuracy, and how to design fallbacks.
* Hands-on builder: you create working automations, agents or prototypes yourself with LLM, workflow or AI coding tools.
* Strong stakeholder management across many senior stakeholders with conflicting priorities, and comfort with rapid change.
* Ability to map operational workflows, find bottlenecks and convert them into product requirements.
* Experience writing PRDs and working with engineering through the sprint cycle.
* Experience launching features and driving adoption using product analytics and user feedback.
* Comfortable working with designers: clear briefs and structured feedback.
* Structured, detail-oriented approach to documentation, and excellent written and verbal communication.

**Technical Requirements:**
---------------------------

* **AI architecture:** LLM APIs, prompt design, retrieval (RAG), agents, evaluation, guardrails and human-in-the-loop design, plus cost, latency and data privacy trade-offs.
* **Workflow and integration tools:** n8n, Zapier, Make or similar; APIs, webhooks and integrations with ATS, CRM and VMS systems.
* **AI coding tools:** Active working knowledge of Claude Code, Codex or Cursor to prototype, debug or ship small changes independently.
* **Architecture basics:** APIs, databases, queues and how web and mobile applications are built, enough for informed conversations with engineering.
* **Product and project management:** Jira, Linear, Asana, Trello or similar; Confluence, Notion, Google Workspace.
* **Design and prototyping:** Figma (or similar) and AI design tools such as Figma AI or Uizard.
* **Analytics and reporting:** Mixpanel, Amplitude or Google Analytics dashboards; strong Excel / Sheets.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Experience with ATS, CRM or VMS platforms and the staffing lifecycle.
* Experience building or launching AI agents or AI-powered product features.
* Familiarity with data privacy and statutory compliance in Indian staffing (e.g. DPDP Act, onboarding documentation).
* Exposure to no-code / low-code tools for internal tooling.

**Why join BYLD:**

**Perks & Benefits:**

* Learn directly from industry experts with 20+ years of experience
* Opportunity to work in a dynamic and collaborative environment.
* Professional development and growth opportunities.
* Gain experience in world class management practices
* Insurance Benefits (Medical and Accidental) for all employees
* Multi-level Rewards programs for all employees

**Follow us:**

– https://linkedin.com/company/byld-group

– https://facebook.com/BYLDGroup

– https://twitter.com/BYLDGroup

title: Product Manager - Liquidity & Account Solutions Product Development - Vice President
job_description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

Shape the future of global liquidity by helping deliver modern, client-first capabilities at scale. Join a team where you will partner across product, technology, and operations to turn complex needs into delivered outcomes. Bring your product and analysis expertise to a role with strong visibility, growth opportunities, and mobility across a global payments organization.

As a Product Vice President at JPMorganChase within Payments, Liquidity and Account Solutions Product Development, you will drive delivery of money market fund capabilities as part of a multi-year liquidity platform transformation. You will act as a primary liaison between product owners and technology delivery teams to define clear requirements and enable predictable execution. You will translate current-state behaviors and client needs into a prioritized backlog of features, user stories, and acceptance criteria. You will partner with engineering, operations, user experience, and business stakeholders to deliver agreed milestones with strong quality and risk discipline. You will help ensure solutions are scalable, user-friendly, and aligned to evolving market and regulatory expectations.

This role supports a global initiative modernizing liquidity and account services for large multinational corporate and financial institution clients. The work spans multiple regions and stakeholder groups and requires strong coordination across product, technology, and operational partners. You will help close current-state gaps while defining a clear target state that supports faster product innovation and improved client experience. Success will be measured through delivery of prioritized capabilities, clarity of documentation, and effective stakeholder alignment. Coverage flexibility is required to support United States business hours through 12:00 p.m. Eastern Time, with occasional extension based on critical delivery needs.

Job Responsibilities

* **Develop** deep domain knowledge of liquidity and money market fund offerings, including client workflows, constraints, and value drivers.
* **Lead** cross-functional execution across product, engineering, operations, and regional stakeholders to deliver committed milestones.
* **Analyze** existing processes and documentation to understand current-state behavior and identify gaps, risks, and improvement opportunities.
* **Define** target-state requirements using clear artifacts such as epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and process flows.
* **Own** backlog prioritization and readiness by running refinement sessions and maintaining a delivery-ready pipeline of work.
* **Validate** sprint outcomes against acceptance criteria and coordinate timely resolution of scope and requirement questions.
* **Support** test planning and execution by ensuring scenarios cover requirements and by assisting with user acceptance testing and defect triage.
* **Drive** stakeholder communication by translating complex technical, operational, and regulatory inputs into clear decisions and next steps.
* **Contribute** to operating model and governance improvements, including disciplined risk and control practices and data/analytics ways of working.

Required qualifications, capabilities and skills

* Bachelor's degree and prior experience in a product manager, digital product owner, business analyst or equivalent role.
* Prior experience as a product manager, digital product owner, business analyst, or equivalent role.
* Demonstrated ability to produce and manage requirements artifacts (for example, epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, and process flows).
* Demonstrated ability to partner effectively with technology teams and business stakeholders to deliver outcomes.
* Demonstrated written and verbal communication skills, including ability to simplify complex concepts for senior stakeholders.
* Ability to work in a delivery-oriented environment with strong organization, attention to detail, and follow-through.
* Commitment to sound risk and control practices.
* Flexibility to support business coverage needs through 12:00 p.m. Eastern Time (with occasional extensions based on delivery needs).

Preferred qualifications, capabilities and skills

* Experience with liquidity and/or money market fund products.
* Experience working with data analysis, large datasets, and/or modeling.
* Experience using digital tools, including artificial intelligence-enabled tools, to accelerate documentation and requirements definition.

**ABOUT US**  
  
  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  
  
**ABOUT THE TEAM**
  
  
J.P. Morgan's Commercial & Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial & Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

job_description:
**Full Time**

Job Code: P-49802 | Purplle.com

Vikhroli, Mumbai, Maharashtra, India

1 position

Expires on 31/12/2026

**Additional Information**

Department

**Product**

Required Experience

**2 - 5 Years**

Skills

**Roadmap & Execution,**

**Demand Planning,**

**S&OP Collaboration**

+ 2 more

**Job Description**

**About the Role**
  
At Purplle, we are building a portfolio of beauty and personal care brands that sell across general trade,
  
modern trade, e-commerce and quick commerce. To scale them, we need a planning system that puts
  
the right product in the right channel at the right time, with the least working capital tied up. We are
  
looking for a Product Manager to build the core of that system: the products that power demand and
  
supply planning for our FMCG business.

  

**This is a high-impact, zero-to-one role.**

* Youll work alongside the Senior Product Manager who leads our demand and supply planning

products, and own the execution and scale-up of our demand planning, S&OP and supply
  
planning products.
  

* Together, you'll replace spreadsheet-based planning with connected demand and supply

planning products that span our own plants and contract manufacturers.
  

* Your products will directly drive forecast accuracy, product availability across channels,

inventory efficiency and working capital, with a tangible impact on the company's bottom line
  
and on how fast our brands can grow.

**Key Responsibilities**
  

* **Roadmap & Execution**: Set a prioritised roadmap with the Senior Product Manager and own

delivery.
  

* **Demand Planning:** Build demand forecasting, sensing and planning at range, channel, product

and region level, including new product forecasting.
  

* **S&OP Collaboration:** Build the tool that runs the monthly S&OP cycle and aligns sales, planning

and finance on one plan.
  

* **Supply Planning:** Take FG Buying live and scale it into end-to-end supply planning.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Work with planners, operations, sales (GT, MT, e-commerce, quick

commerce), finance, data science and engineering to define requirements and drive adoption.
  

* **Discovery & Delivery:** Run discovery with planners, write PRDs and user stories, and manage the

backlog with agile teams.
  

* **KPI Ownership:** Own forecast accuracy and bias, fill rate for modern trade and quick commerce,

inventory health (days, excess, expiry) and adoption of the planning products.
  

* **AI-Native Building:** Identify where AI and LLMs can create outsized value in planning, such as

explaining forecast changes, surfacing demand anomalies and automating routine plan reviews.
  
Build these into the products, not as add-ons, and use AI tools to accelerate your own discovery,
  
specs and analysis.

**Desired Skills and Requirements**
  
  

* About 2 years of product management experience with clear ownership: you have taken

products from discovery through delivery and adoption, ideally in supply chain, operations or
  
internal tools.
  

* Hands-on exposure to demand and supply planning: forecasting and how accuracy is measured,

S&OP, and inventory norms (safety stock, reorder points).
  

* Exposure to Indian general trade, modern trade and quick commerce.
* Strong analytical skills and working knowledge of SQL; you make decisions backed by data.
* First-principles and systems thinking: you break ambiguous problems into structured pieces and

reason about how forecasting, S&OP and supply planning connect.
  

* High ownership and bias for action: you drive problems to resolution without waiting to be told.
* Clear written and verbal communication, and experience working cross-functionally in agile

teams.
  

* Engineering undergraduate degree. An MBA from a Tier 1 business school is good to have.

**Good-to-Have Skills**
  

* Python for analysis or prototyping.
* BI tools such as Looker, Tableau or Metabase.
* Hands-on use of a planning tool such as o9, Kinaxis or SAP IBP.
* Exposure to ML-based forecasting or replenishment products.

**What You Will Gain**
  

* Zero-to-one ownership of demand and supply planning products for a fast-growing FMCG

portfolio.
  

* Monthly S&OP cycle exposure with sales, supply and finance leaders.
* A clear growth path, with your scope expanding as the products scale.

About Company

Founded in 2011, Purplle has emerged as one of India’s premier omnichannel beauty destinations, redefining the way millions shop for beauty. With 1,000+ brands, 60,000+ products, and over 7 million monthly active users, Purplle has built a powerhouse platform that seamlessly blends online and offline experiences.

Expanding its footprint in 2022, Purplle introduced 6,000+ offline touchpoints and launched 100+ stores, strengthening its presence beyond digital. Beyond hosting third-party brands, Purplle has successfully scaled its own D2C powerhouses—FACES CANADA, Good Vibes, Carmesi, Purplle, and NY Bae—offering trend-driven, high-quality beauty essentials.

What sets Purplle apart is its technology driven hyper-personalized shopping experience. By curating detailed user personas, enabling virtual makeup trials, and delivering tailored product recommendations based on personality, search intent, and purchase behavior, Purplle ensures a unique, customer-first approach.

In 2022, Purplle achieved unicorn status, becoming India’s 102nd unicorn, backed by an esteemed group of investors including ADIA, Kedaara, Premji Invest, Sequoia Capital India, JSW Ventures, Goldman Sachs, Verlinvest, Blume Ventures, and Paramark Ventures.

With a 3,000+ strong team and an unstoppable vision, Purplle is set to lead the charge in India’s booming beauty landscape, revolutionizing the way the nation experiences beauty.

Associate Product Manager

Associate Product Manager Bikham, India — Remote We are seeking a highly motivated and intellectually curious Associate Product Manager (APM) to join our growing team. This is an exciting opportunity for an aspiring product leader who is eager to make a significant impact in the US Health Tech space. As an APM, you will play a crucial role in bringing our B2B product vision to life. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including engineering, design, sales, and customer success, to understand user needs, define product requirements, and deliver intuitive, technically sound solutions. A strong understanding of user experience principles and a solid technical foundation are essential, as you'll be navigating complex healthcare workflows and translating them into elegant product features. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced startup environment and demonstrates an exceptional ability to learn, adapt, and drive initiatives forward. Key Responsibilities • Product Lifecycle Support: Assist in defining product requirements, writing user stories, and managing the product backlog for specific features or modules. • Technical Understanding: Bridge the gap between business needs and technical feasibility, working closely with engineers to understand system capabilities and limitations, and ensuring technical solutions align with product goals. • Market & Competitor Analysis: Support market research efforts to identify trends, competitive landscapes, and opportunities within the US Health Tech credentialing and provider management sector. • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Facilitate effective communication and collaboration among engineering, design, sales, marketing, and customer success teams throughout the product development lifecycle. • Data-Driven Decisions: Assist in tracking product performance metrics, analyzing data, and gathering insights to inform product iterations and future strategies. • Stakeholder Communication: Help prepare product updates and communicate progress to internal and external stakeholders. • Learning & Adaptability: Proactively seek out new knowledge, adapt to evolving priorities, and contribute to a culture of continuous learning and innovation. What We're Looking For • Experience: Approximately 2 years of experience in product management, business analysis, software development, or a related role, preferably within a B2B SaaS environment. • User Empathy: A strong passion for understanding user needs and a keen eye for user experience design principles. • Technical Aptitude: Demonstrated ability to understand technical concepts, engage with engineers, and contribute to discussions about system architecture and implementation. • Problem-Solving: Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to break down complex problems into manageable solutions. Page 1 • Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills, capable of articulating complex ideas clearly and concisely to diverse audiences. • Collaboration: A collaborative spirit with the ability to work effectively in a team-oriented environment. • Curiosity & Drive: A self-starter with a strong desire to learn, grow, and take initiative in a dynamic startup setting. • Education: We prioritize your ability to deliver outstanding results and your practical understanding of Product Landscape. While a formal degree can be helpful, it is not a strict requirement if you can demonstrate your capabilities. Bonus Points • Experience in the US healthcare industry or health tech. • Familiarity with credentialing, privileging, or provider management processes. • Experience with product analytics tools

job_description:
Experience: 1–3 years  
Location: Bengaluru (Work from Office – Domlur)

**About the Role**
------------------

We are looking for an Associate Product Manager who is proactive, comfortable with ambiguity, and excited about building AI-first products.

You should be someone who takes ownership, figures things out independently, and enjoys solving problems. We value people who can move fast, experiment, and get things done without needing constant direction.

### **What You'll Do**

* Own product initiatives end-to-end, from identifying problems to launching solutions and measuring impact.
* Work on AI-first products, identifying opportunities to use GenAI and automation to improve user experience and business outcomes.
* Conduct customer research, understand user pain points, and translate insights into product improvements.
* Work closely with Engineering, Design, and Business teams to build and ship products.
* Define and track product metrics, analyze funnels, and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Build quick prototypes, test ideas, and iterate based on feedback and data.
* Contribute to product strategy and roadmap discussions.

### **What We're Looking For**

* Education: Bachelor's degree from a Tier 1 institution, preferably in Engineering or a technical discipline.
* Experience: 1–3 years in Product Management, Engineering, Analytics, or related roles.
* High agency: Someone who takes initiative, works independently, and finds ways to get things done.
* AI-first mindset: Actively uses AI tools in day-to-day work and is curious about building products using AI.
* Problem-solving: Strong analytical skills and the ability to break down ambiguous problems.
* Product sense: Good understanding of user experience and what makes a product work well.
* Communication: Ability to communicate clearly and work with different teams.

### **Good to Have**

* Experience building AI agents, prototypes, or side projects using tools like Cursor, Claude Code, or Replit.
* Experience with consumer products, growth, or monetisation.
* Familiarity with CRM tools, SEO, or digital marketing.
* Previous startup or 01 product experience.

We are particularly interested in people who have built something on their own, whether it's a side project, a small product, or an AI-powered tool. We care about what you've done, not just the roles you've held.

TransUnion's Job Applicant Privacy Notice

**Team Overview**

The Technical Platform Manager (TPM) is responsible for driving the strategy, roadmap, adoption, governance, and delivery of enterprise platform services that enable secure, scalable, and efficient software development and infrastructure operations across the organization.
  
  
This role partners with platform service owners, engineering leaders, architecture, security, compliance, cloud engineering, and application development teams to define platform capabilities, establish operational excellence standards, drive platform adoption, and deliver measurable business outcomes. The TPM serves as a strategic leader who balances platform scalability, reliability, security, developer experience, and cost optimization while ensuring enterprise platform services continue to meet evolving business and technology needs.
  
  
Platform domains may include Data Ingestion, Data Quality, ETL, Web Applications, Observability, Infrastructure Automation, PKI and Certificate Lifecycle Management , Developer Tooling, and Internal Developer Platforms.
  
  
This is a hybrid position and involves regular performance of job responsibilities virtually as well as in-person at an assigned TU office location for a minimum of two days a week.
  
  
This is a hybrid position and involves regular performance of job responsibilities virtually as well as in-person at an assigned TU office location for a minimum of two days a week.

This is a hybrid position and involves regular performance of job responsibilities virtually as well as in-person at an assigned TU office location for a minimum of two days a week.  
  

**Role Overview And Core Responsibilities**

**Data Platform Strategy & Roadmap Management**

* Define and manage the product roadmap for enterprise data acquisition, ingestion, correction, storage, and distribution platforms, including:
  + Data Acquisition & Onboarding Services
  + Data Ingestion Pipelines (Batch and Real-Time)
  + Data Quality & Validation Services
  + Data Correction Platforms (Consumer, Commercial, Fraud, MFI)
  + Enterprise Data Store (EDS)
  + Data Publishing & Distribution Services
  + CDC, Streaming, and Event-Driven Architecture
  + Redis and Low-Latency Data Access Platforms
  + Data APIs and Data-as-a-Service Capabilities
* Establish product vision and strategy for enterprise data platforms aligned with business growth, regulatory requirements, and customer needs.
* Drive prioritisation of platform investments that improve data quality, scalability, timeliness, availability, and operational efficiency.
* Partner with Engineering, Architecture, Product, Analytics, and Operations teams to define roadmap alignment, capability evolution, and technical strategy.
* Balance regulatory obligations, technical debt reduction, platform modernization, and business-driven feature delivery.

**Data Product Adoption & Customer Success**

* Drive adoption of enterprise data platform capabilities across internal and external consumers.
* Develop deep understanding of data providers, operational users, analytics teams, product teams, and application consumers.
* Establish feedback loops with stakeholders to continuously improve data acquisition, correction, fulfilment, and data access experiences.
* Measure and report product adoption, service utilisation, customer satisfaction, data quality improvements, and business value realization.
* Champion self-service capabilities that enable data onboarding, monitoring, corrections, and operational management with minimal engineering intervention.

**Data Governance & Operational Excellence**

* Define and maintain operational frameworks governing data ingestion, validation, correction, retention, distribution, and lifecycle management.
* Establish KPIs and success metrics across:
  + Data Availability
  + Pipeline Throughput
  + Data Freshness
  + Data Accuracy
  + Data Completeness
  + Data Quality Scores
  + Operational SLA Compliance
  + Customer Adoption
  + Platform Reliability
* Partner with Security, Risk, Compliance, and Data Governance teams to ensure alignment with enterprise policies and regulatory obligations.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives focused on operational resilience, platform scalability, automation, and reduction of manual intervention.
* Drive root-cause analysis and corrective actions for data quality, performance, and availability incidents.

**Product Delivery & Program Leadership**

* Lead cross-functional delivery initiatives spanning multiple data and technology organizations.
* Own product planning activities including:
  + Roadmaps
  + Business cases
  + Prioritization
  + Scope management
  + Release planning
  + Dependency management
* Facilitate Agile execution, Program Increment planning, roadmap reviews, stakeholder governance forums, and executive reporting.
* Ensure successful delivery of data platform capabilities while balancing customer experience, operational excellence, security, and compliance requirements.
* Manage complex dependencies across ingestion, correction, storage, analytics, API, and fulfillment ecosystems.

**Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Coordinate initiatives involving:
  + Enterprise Architecture
  + Data Architecture
  + Information Security
  + Regulatory & Compliance Teams
  + Data Governance
  + Analytics & Data Science
  + Cloud & Infrastructure Engineering
  + Application Development Teams
  + Business Product Owners
  + Operations & Support Organizations
* Build alignment across diverse stakeholder groups with competing priorities.
* Influence enterprise-wide decisions regarding data architecture, governance frameworks, platform standards, and operating models.
* Act as the primary product leader for enterprise data platform capabilities and strategic modernization initiatives.

  

* 8+ years of experience as a Technical Product Manager, Technical Program Manager, Platform Product Manager, or equivalent leadership role.
* 5+ years of experience delivering enterprise-scale data platforms, data products, ingestion services, or data management solutions.
* Experience defining and executing data platform strategy, roadmap development, adoption plans, and product lifecycle management.
* Strong understanding of enterprise data ecosystems including:
  + Data Acquisition
  + Data Ingestion
  + Data Quality Management
  + Data Correction Workflows
  + Master Data Management
  + Data Distribution
  + Data Governance
* Experience working with both real-time and batch processing architectures.
* Strong knowledge of enterprise data architecture patterns including:
  + Event-driven architecture
  + Streaming platforms
  + Data pipelines
  + API-driven integrations
  + Data products
* Experience managing products supporting multiple internal and external customers.
* Experience establishing and reporting product KPIs and operational metrics.
* Proven ability to influence executive leadership, engineering organizations, and business stakeholders.
* Demonstrated success delivering large-scale, highly regulated, enterprise data initiatives.
* Strong ownership mindset with experience managing risks, dependencies, and commitments across multiple delivery teams.
* Experience working with globally distributed teams across multiple geographies and time zones.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and executive presentation skills.  

  

**Required Knowledge And Experiences**

* Enterprise Data Platforms and Data Warehousing concepts.
* Data Ingestion Technologies including:
  + Kafka
  + CDC Platforms
  + Streaming Solutions
  + ETL/ELT Frameworks
  + Event-Driven Architectures
* Enterprise databases including:
  + PostgreSQL
  + SQL Server
  + Oracle
  + NoSQL Technologies
* Caching and low-latency data access platforms:
  + Redis
  + Distributed Caching Platforms
  + In-memory Data Technologies
* API Management and Data Services:
  + REST
  + gRPC
  + Event APIs
  + Data Service Layers
* Cloud platforms:
  + AWS
  + Azure
  + GCP
* Data Quality and Observability platforms.
* Data Governance, Metadata Management, and Data Lineage concepts.
* Agile delivery tools including Jira, Confluence, and enterprise planning platforms.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting enterprise credit, risk, fraud, identity, or financial data ecosystems.
* Knowledge of consumer, commercial, fraud, or alternative data acquisition and fulfilment processes.
* Experience with data correction and dispute management platforms.
* Experience with Data Mesh, Data Product, or Data-as-a-Service operating models.
* Familiarity with regulatory and compliance frameworks governing data management and consumer information.
* Experience leading enterprise data modernization, cloud migration, or platform transformation initiatives.
* Experience presenting platform strategy, data quality trends, adoption metrics, and business outcomes to senior executive leadership.
Strong understanding of data operations, service reliability, and operational excellence practices.  

  

**TransUnion Overview:**

At TransUnion, we encourage and are committed to creating a real, positive impact and shared sense of purpose within our **Workforce for Good** , which empowers our people to grow, innovate and contribute to a better future for our communities and customers. We strive to build an environment where our associates are in the driver’s seat of their professional development— while having access to help along the way. We recognize that success comes when our associates thrive both professionally and personally; that’s why we prioritize work/life flexibility and offer resources for our teams across the globe to collaborate and drive excellence.

  

Be a part of our **Workforce for Good** – you’ll work with great people, pioneering products and cutting-edge technology.

Sr Consultant, Product Management
