Job Title: Associate Product Manager - AI-Powered Reconciliation Platform

City: Chennai

State/Province: Tamil Nadu

Posting Start Date: 10/23/26

Wipro Limited (NYSE: WIT, BSE: 507685, NSE: WIPRO) is a leading technology services and consulting company focused on building innovative solutions that address clients’ most complex digital transformation needs. Leveraging our holistic portfolio of capabilities in consulting, design, engineering, and operations, we help clients realize their boldest ambitions and build future-ready, sustainable businesses. With over 230,000 employees and business partners across 65 countries, we deliver on the promise of helping our customers, colleagues, and communities thrive in an ever-changing world. For additional information, visit us at www.wipro.com.

**Associate Product Manager – AI-Powered Reconciliation Platform**

**Location:** Chennai, India (Preferred) | **Experience:** 7–10 Years | **Domain:** Securities & Capital Markets

**About the Role**

We are looking for an APM to help build an AI-powered Capital Markets Reconciliation Platform. Reporting to the Product Manager, the APM will contribute to product vision, strategy, roadmap, UX and GTM. The role requires capital-markets expertise to translate reconciliation and exception processes into scalable, AI-driven capabilities.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Product Strategy & Roadmap**

* Partner with the Product Manager to define product vision, positioning and roadmap.
* Track customer needs, regulations, competitors and AI trends to identify high-value opportunities.

**Domain & Product Capabilities**

* Understand workflows across buy/sell-side, asset managers, brokers, custodians, clearing firms and fund administrators.
* Define trade/broker, cash, positions, settlement, custodian, books-and-records, fees/commissions, margin/collateral, corporate actions, NAV, valuation, accounting and inter-system reconciliations.
* Define data ingestion, enrichment, matching/rules, tolerances, break detection, exception/case workflows, escalation, audit and reporting.

**AI, UX & Innovation**

* Define AI capabilities for intelligent matching, break classification, root-cause analysis, anomaly detection, evidence gathering, resolution recommendations and automated exception resolution.
* Evolve reconciliation toward predictive and autonomous operations.
* Design UX for operations, supervisors and controls, enabling exception-based management.
* Embed human oversight, explainability, traceability and responsible-AI principles.

**Platform & Ecosystem**

* Define integration with OMS/EMS, trading platforms, brokers, custodians, clearing infrastructure, accounting, data providers and books-and-records systems.
* Shape APIs, security, entitlements, auditability, scalability and multi-asset/multi-currency processing.

**Preferred Credentials**

* 7–10 years of experience in product management/ownership or capital-markets operations/technology related to reconciliation.
* Strong knowledge of trade/post-trade lifecycle, reconciliation, settlement and exception management.
* Exposure to equities, fixed income, FX and derivatives preferred.
* Experience with reconciliation or middle/back-office platforms desirable.
* Understanding of AI/ML, GenAI, Agentic AI, data platforms, workflow automation and API-based architectures.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Finance, Business or related discipline; MBA, CFA or relevant certification desirable.

title: Product Lead
job_description:
At Broadridge, we've built a culture where the highest goal is to empower others to accomplish more. If you’re passionate about developing your career, while helping others along the way, come join the Broadridge team.

**Product Lead – Skills**

1. Strong domain and business knowledge in relevant product, operations, and technology areas.

2. Experience working with agile product delivery teams across multiple squads.

3. Strong knowledge of backlog management, prioritization, release planning, and dependency management.

4. Ability to assess business value, urgency, risks, capacity constraints, and delivery trade-offs.

5. Experience using Jira, ESM, dashboards, and reporting tools for backlog and delivery visibility.

6. Strong stakeholder management skills across Product, Engineering, Delivery, Operations, SMEs, and business teams.

7. Ability to translate product strategy and business needs into actionable priorities for squads.

8. Strong communication, influencing, and problem-solving skills.

9. Experience coaching or mentoring Product Owners, Business Analysts, or similar roles.

10. Understanding of functional requirements, non-functional requirements, technical debt, production support, and continuous improvement.

11. Ability to work effectively in a complex environment with high request volumes and competing priorities.

12. Understanding of agile principles, product operating models, and governance practices.

**Product Lead – Roles & Responsibilities**

1. Act as the domain-level product lead for a defined area, such as Core, Print, or Voting/Tabulation/Edit Load.

2. Translate Product Manager strategy, roadmap priorities, and business objectives into clear direction for Product Owners and squads.

3. Support prioritization and sequencing of work across squads, including discretionary initiatives, run/OCC work, lite requests, regulatory work, production support, and technical debt.

4. Review incoming requests for business value, urgency, timelines, dependencies, impacted squads, capacity implications, and governance needs.

5. Ensure requests are categorized and prioritized using agreed criteria, such as Critical, High, Medium, and Low.

6. Work with Product Owners to align squad backlogs with domain priorities, roadmap commitments, and available capacity.

7. Guide Product Owners on backlog quality, requirement readiness, prioritization, stakeholder communication, and dependency management.

8. Participate in key business and refinement discussions for complex, high-priority, cross-squad, or high-risk initiatives.

9. Ensure appropriate SME involvement for discovery, technical clarification, spikes, and requirement validation.

10.Coordinate with Delivery Managers, Engineering leaders, QA leads, SMEs, and Scrum Masters on delivery constraints, dependencies, and sequencing impacts.

11. Maintain visibility into domain-level capacity, delivery risks, blockers, resource constraints, and impacts to roadmap commitments.

12. Identify and escalate priority conflicts, major trade-offs, cross-squad dependencies, and delivery risks to the Product Manager when needed.

13. Support domain intake reviews, backlog reviews, prioritization discussions, and governance preparation.

14. Provide regular domain-level updates on priorities, progress, risks, capacity, dependencies, and milestone impacts.

15. Coach and support Product Owners; where needed, directly perform Product Owner responsibilities for specific initiatives, including gathering requirements, creating/refining stories, managing backlog items, and supporting delivery through completion.

We are dedicated to fostering a collaborative, engaging, and inclusive environment and are committed to providing a workplace that empowers associates to be authentic and bring their best to work. We believe that associates do their best when they feel safe, understood, and valued, and we work diligently and collaboratively to ensure Broadridge is a company—and ultimately a community—that recognizes and celebrates everyone’s unique perspective.

**Use of AI in Hiring**

As part of the recruiting process, Broadridge may use technology, including artificial intelligence (AI)-based tools, to help review and evaluate applications. These tools are used only to support our recruiters and hiring managers, and all employment decisions include human review to ensure fairness, accuracy, and compliance with applicable laws. Please note that honesty and transparency are critical to our hiring process. Any attempt to falsify, misrepresent, or disguise information in an application, resume, assessment, or interview will result in disqualification from consideration.

Job Code: P-81318 | Purplle.com

**Job Description**

**About the Team**
  
Purplle’s Product Management team builds the technology products that power a comprehensive e-commerce platform. The team constantly ships new supply chain features that are scalable, reduce cost, and enhance customer experience. As a team, every individual is expected to make a significant, measurable impact on the business.

**About the Role**
  
We are looking for an Associate Product Manager who will own the product charter for B2B logistics, covering how we move goods to retailers, distributors, modern trade, marketplaces, and institutional buyers, as well as stock movement between our plants and warehouses. You will work at the intersection of product, logistics operations, and finance systems, turning the needs of operations and business stakeholders into reliable, well-built features. This is an individual contributor role with end to end ownership of the B2B logistics roadmap and its business impact. You will work closely with backend engineering, the SAP team, operations, and logistics partners to deliver it.

**Key Responsibilities**

**B2B Logistics Product Ownership**

* Own the product roadmap for B2B logistics flows, including customer orders, stock transfers between locations, and B2B returns, prioritised by business impact.
* Translate operational problems into clear Product Requirement Documents, use cases, and acceptance criteria for engineering and QA.
* Lead initiatives such as automatic carrier enablement for B2B shipments and the CPG forward and returns flow, from problem definition to rollout and adoption.
* Partner with backend engineering to design, build, and roll out new features, and drive adoption with operations teams.
* Maintain a separate B2B layer for carrier and logistics partner integrations, and coordinate with the B2C logistics owner on anything shared.

**Delivery Reliability and Network Performance**

* Own delivery promise reliability for B2B orders, defining and tracking the metrics that show whether commitments to customers are met.
* Improve network cost, capacity, and delivery performance across carriers and lanes through structured product changes.
* Identify workflow gaps and inefficiencies on the ground and define improvements that scale.

**Compliance and ERP (SAP)**

* Own B2B compliance flows such as e-way bills and invoicing, and keep them aligned with SAP.
* Support integration and data consistency between the warehouse systems, logistics partners, and SAP for sales, stock movement, and returns.
* Work with engineering, finance, and operations to debug system-level discrepancies and drive root causes to closure.

**Governance, Analytics, and Stakeholders**

* Drive operations governance and risk reduction by defining clear processes, escalation paths, and checks that prevent repeat failures.
* Use logistics data and dashboards to track performance, surface insights, and drive data-informed product decisions.
* Delegate and escalate effectively, and push repeatable manual work toward automation.
* Communicate progress, risks, and trade-offs clearly to operations, business, and engineering stakeholders.

**Must-Have Skills and Requirements**

* 1+ years of experience in a product, analytics, or supply-chain technology role.
* BE / B.Tech from a reputed institute. MBA is a plus but not mandatory.
* Strong product fundamentals, including the ability to write clear PRDs and use cases, prioritise by impact, and work in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities.
* Working understanding of ERP systems such as SAP and how sales, invoicing, and compliance data flow through them.
* Solid data analysis fundamentals and the ability to understand discrepancies across systems.
* Strong verbal and written communication and stakeholder management skills across product, engineering, operations, and finance teams.
* High ownership mindset with the ability to drive a problem from identification to resolution.

**Good-to-Have Skills**

* Exposure to logistics, 3PL, carrier management, or B2B supply chain operations.
* Working knowledge of SQL and comfort querying datasets in a cloud warehouse such as BigQuery.
* Hands-on experience with BI or data visualization tools such as Looker, Tableau, or Metabase.
* Familiarity with e-way bill and GST compliance in the Indian supply chain context.
* Exposure to Warehouse Management Systems or quick-commerce operations.

**What You Will Gain**

* End to end ownership of the B2B logistics charter, from roadmap to measurable impact.
* A role at the intersection of product, supply chain, and technology, with real influence on the roadmap.
* Deep exposure to carrier integrations, compliance flows, and SAP across a high-volume e-commerce supply chain.
* A clear growth path from Associate Product Manager toward a full Product Manager role.

About Company

Founded in 2011, Purplle has emerged as one of India’s premier omnichannel beauty destinations, redefining the way millions shop for beauty. With 1,000+ brands, 60,000+ products, and over 7 million monthly active users, Purplle has built a powerhouse platform that seamlessly blends online and offline experiences.

Expanding its footprint in 2022, Purplle introduced 6,000+ offline touchpoints and launched 100+ stores, strengthening its presence beyond digital. Beyond hosting third-party brands, Purplle has successfully scaled its own D2C powerhouses—FACES CANADA, Good Vibes, Carmesi, Purplle, and NY Bae—offering trend-driven, high-quality beauty essentials.

What sets Purplle apart is its technology driven hyper-personalized shopping experience. By curating detailed user personas, enabling virtual makeup trials, and delivering tailored product recommendations based on personality, search intent, and purchase behavior, Purplle ensures a unique, customer-first approach.

In 2022, Purplle achieved unicorn status, becoming India’s 102nd unicorn, backed by an esteemed group of investors including ADIA, Kedaara, Premji Invest, Sequoia Capital India, JSW Ventures, Goldman Sachs, Verlinvest, Blume Ventures, and Paramark Ventures.

With a 3,000+ strong team and an unstoppable vision, Purplle is set to lead the charge in India’s booming beauty landscape, revolutionizing the way the nation experiences beauty.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Associate Director - Product Owner - LES
job_description:
**About the Team:**

Enterprise Systems is the backbone of GSK’s internal operations in Digital & Tech, enabling GSK Global Functions teams such as Finance, Procurement, HR, Legal, Compliance, WREF, CGA and Corporate Secretariat to run seamlessly. This team designs and delivers cutting-edge digital platforms that power critical processes, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and scalability across the enterprise.

Enterprise Systems Management & Business Operations delivers digital solutions that support Enterprise Systems running as a high-performing organisation. This team drives financial discipline, operational rigour and strategic alignment across the ES portfolio that safeguard GSK’s integrity and reputation globally. By joining this team, you’ll help shape systems that support thousands of employees worldwide, driving innovation and reliability in the tools that keep GSK moving forward.

**Job Purpose:**

The Product Owner is responsible for maximising the value, compliance, adoption, and operational performance of the LabWare Lab Execution System (LES) used to digitise and control QC laboratory test execution. The role translates QC, Quality, site, and regulatory needs into a prioritised LabWare LES backlog and leads delivery across the product lifecycle within strategic, financial, architectural, and GxP guardrails set by the Product Manager and Product Domain Lead. The Product Owner works closely with laboratory stakeholders, Quality, CSV, Tech, suppliers, and delivery teams to ensure LabWare LES capabilities are usable, validated, secure, supportable, inspection-ready, and aligned to standardised laboratory execution processes.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Partner with QC laboratory, Quality, site, and digital stakeholders to understand laboratory execution needs and define LabWare LES outcomes that improve compliance, data integrity, analyst experience, and operational efficiency.
* Own and manage the LabWare LES product backlog, ensuring epics, features, user stories, configuration needs, master data impacts, reporting requirements, validation expectations, and dependencies are clearly defined and prioritised.
* Make backlog prioritisation decisions based on GxP impact, business value, laboratory criticality, data integrity risk, defect severity, release capacity, cost, and cross-site standardisation opportunities, escalating strategic trade-offs to the Product Manager or Product Domain Lead.
* Lead delivery activities for LabWare LES changes, guiding Product Analysts, configuration specialists, testers, CSV resources, architects, engineers, and supplier teams to ensure solutions are fit-for-purpose, validated, secure, supportable, and aligned to architecture and quality standards.
* Ensure LabWare LES changes support controlled laboratory execution, including electronic worksheets, procedural step guidance, calculations, specifications, instrument or system interfaces, review-by-exception, audit trails, electronic signatures, and exception handling where applicable.
* Drive operational readiness by ensuring support model impacts, SOP updates, training materials, release communications, cutover plans, hypercare, runbooks, and knowledge transfer are in place before deployment.
* Maintain product performance measures for LabWare LES, including adoption, release throughput, defects, incident trends, validation progress, user experience signals, support effort, and benefits realisation; use insights to drive continuous improvement.
* Ensure product changes comply with GxP, CSV, data integrity, security, privacy, access control, change control, and supplier governance expectations, obtaining input and approvals from Quality, CSV, Security, Architecture, and other SMEs where required.
* Support Solution Architects and technical teams in assessing design options, integrations, environment management, reporting, performance, and dependencies with LIMS, instruments, ERP, document management, identity management, and other connected systems.
* Act as an escalation point for LabWare LES functional issues, defects, prioritisation conflicts, and release readiness decisions, balancing business continuity, compliance risk, user impact, and delivery capacity.
* Promote agile, iterative, value-driven delivery practices while maintaining the discipline required for validated systems, including traceability from requirements through design, build, testing, approval, release, and ongoing periodic review.

**Basic Requirements:**

**Education:** Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Life Sciences or related field (or equivalent experience).

* Typically 5+ years of experience in product delivery, laboratory informatics, LabWare LIMS / LES, QC laboratory systems, or process-led technology roles in a regulated environment.
* Proven experience defining, prioritising, and delivering requirements for laboratory execution, LIMS / LES, electronic worksheets, analytical workflows, reporting, interfaces, or validated laboratory systems.
* Experience working directly with QC laboratories, Quality, CSV, IT, suppliers, and site stakeholders to translate laboratory needs into feasible, compliant, value-led technology changes.
* Demonstrated ability to prioritise based on GxP impact, data integrity risk, user impact, business continuity, technical complexity, cost, and delivery capacity.
* Experience supporting validated system delivery, including requirements, configuration, testing, defect triage, release readiness, change control, and deployment into controlled laboratory environments.
* Familiarity with regulated change management, periodic review, audit trail review expectations, user access governance, supplier management, and quality documentation for GxP systems.
* Exposure to continuous improvement approaches that simplify laboratory processes, reduce manual transcription, improve right-first-time execution, and increase adoption of standardised digital laboratory ways of working.
* Experience working within agile or hybrid delivery environments while maintaining appropriate validation, traceability, and release controls for regulated systems.

**Skills**

Agile Methodology, Backlogs, Cross-Functional Teamwork, Design Thinking, DevOps, Process Diagrams, Product Strategies, Project Management, Requirements Gathering, Services Management, Software Development, User Experience (UX), User Research, User Story

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Inclusion at GSK:**

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

It has come to our attention that the names of GlaxoSmithKline or GSK or our group companies are being used in connection with bogus job advertisements or through unsolicited emails asking candidates to make some payments for recruitment opportunities and interview. Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.

**GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.**

If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk.com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in “gsk.com”, you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk.com, so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

At Broadridge, we've built a culture where the highest goal is to empower others to accomplish more. If you’re passionate about developing your career, while helping others along the way, come join the Broadridge team.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Oversight** **& Best Practices:** Optimize product management processes, employing AI where possible and proactively identify areas for standardization and improved efficiency (e.g. Service Descriptions), document and implement.
* **Roadmap Support**: Oversee process for product managers in developing and managing roadmaps; coordinating feedback for process improvements, and preparing client and senior management-ready roadmap views near on-demand.
* **Governance Coordination**: Support execution of annual **Wealth Investment Governance Board** by defining and coordinating PM driven templates, supporting content creation, execute logistics and run of show and following up on actions.
* **Strategic Support**: Opportunity to contribute to ad hoc strategic client or internal projects and initiatives as directed by Senior Management, such as documentation and coordination across product for Strat Planning, Growth Day and Client Sales Opportunities.
* **AI:** Assist teams in utilizing BR AI tools to capture valuable product insights that support their strategies and client adoption. Contributing to and supporting the Wealth AI task force, and ideating on new innovations to support the COE and managing reporting and metrics.

**What Success Looks Like:**

  

* Implemented Service Description workflow and attestation process, including coordinated legal updates and tracking of common elements.
* Ability to produce on-demand roadmaps by product or Wealth overall as required both from clients and internally
* Efficiently executed internal events that impact and advance our strategic Wealth initiatives, providing clear actions and follow ups with stakeholders and clients.
* Become a Go-To Product COE expert in support of our Product teams, ensuring their success in delivering high quality roadmaps, ideas and processes.
* Delivery of well documented processes and best practices available to all associates, maintained and updated consistently
* AI driven process ideation and implementation of our product management process, creating efficiencies and best practices adopted across the COE.

We are dedicated to fostering a collaborative, engaging, and inclusive environment and are committed to providing a workplace that empowers associates to be authentic and bring their best to work. We believe that associates do their best when they feel safe, understood, and valued, and we work diligently and collaboratively to ensure Broadridge is a company—and ultimately a community—that recognizes and celebrates everyone’s unique perspective.

**Use of AI in Hiring**

As part of the recruiting process, Broadridge may use technology, including artificial intelligence (AI)-based tools, to help review and evaluate applications. These tools are used only to support our recruiters and hiring managers, and all employment decisions include human review to ensure fairness, accuracy, and compliance with applicable laws. Please note that honesty and transparency are critical to our hiring process. Any attempt to falsify, misrepresent, or disguise information in an application, resume, assessment, or interview will result in disqualification from consideration.

Experience: 3 to 6 Years Job Requisition: TBD  
About the Role  
We’re seeking a Business Analyst / Product Owner with strong expertise in U.S. tax reporting and securities processing. You’ll act as the bridge between business stakeholders and engineering teams, ensuring our products meet complex IRS requirements while driving operational efficiency for global clients. This role combines product ownership, business analysis, and Agile/Scrum leadership to deliver impactful financial solutions.  
Key Responsibilities  

Product Ownership  
Define and prioritize product backlog items with a focus on IRS/regulatory compliance (cost basis, income reclassification, tax form production).  
Act as Product Owner in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, ensuring clear user stories, acceptance criteria, and alignment with business goals.  

Agile & Scrum Delivery  
Collaborate with Scrum Masters and development teams to drive sprint planning, backlog refinement, and timely delivery.  
Champion Agile practices, fostering transparency, adaptability, and continuous improvement across teams.  

Cross-Functional Collaboration  
Partner with Development, QA teams across geographies to deliver scalable, compliant solutions.  
Facilitate workshops, sprint reviews, and retrospectives to align stakeholders and ensure shared understanding of product goals.  

Client Engagement  
Work directly with clients and partners to capture reporting needs, regulatory changes, and operational challenges.  
Translate complex tax and securities requirements into actionable user stories and product features.  

Domain Expertise  
Apply deep knowledge of IRS/regulatory practices, withholding, corporate actions, and back-office operations.  
Ensure solutions meet tax reporting/regulatory standards with accuracy, reliability, and audit readiness.  
Qualifications  

Hands-on industry experience in U.S. Tax Reporting and Securities Processing.  

Strong knowledge of IRS requirements for cost basis, income, withholding, and form production.  

Experience with back-office platforms (BPS, BETA preferred).  

Demonstrated success working in Agile/Scrum environments as a Product Owner or Business Analyst.  

Technical expertise in SQL, PostgreSQL, and Power BI for advanced data analysis, reporting, and visualization.  

Strong communication abilities, adept at engaging with clients and stakeholders.  

Education: BE / B.Tech / MCA / MBA or equivalent.
